Time-Zone: U.S. Central Time (CST)

Terms: Full-time, Independent contractor

Compensation: $7/hr, negotiable based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Anavah Talent is a privately-held overseas staffing startup based in the U.S. We help top U.S. businesses (from celebrity-backed CPG firms to Y Combinator-backed AI startups) hire exceptional remote talent overseas without going through BPOs. We care deeply about providing dignified, redemptive work for people in the Philippines.

We are looking for a Client Account Manager to own the client journey from consultative sales (led by our Founder) through recruitment delivery to onboarding to retention and upsells / overall client success. This role is critical to our growth strategy: allowing our founder to focus on closing new business while you work on delivery + retention. There will be step-up opportunities to define the function, help close deals, and work cross functionally with our awesome teammates.

ABOUT YOU:

Are you client-focused, proactive, and process-driven? Do you enjoy building order, systems, and consistency while managing multiple stakeholders? The right person will take ownership of client delivery, anticipate challenges, and maintain high client satisfaction. You will work cross-functionally with Recruiting, Operations, and Finance to ensure a seamless, world-class experience for every client.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client Onboarding & Post-Sales Delivery

  • Lead client kick-off calls to align expectations, define roles, and clarify hiring needs.
  • Own the client experience immediately after engagement and deposit.
  • Communicate the recruitment process step-by-step, including timelines, communication cadence, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate with the Recruitment team to ensure sourcing and shortlisting begin promptly.

Recruitment Process Management

  • Serve as the main point of contact between clients and internal teams.
  • Ensure candidate shortlists are delivered, interviews are scheduled, and feedback is collected timely.
  • Follow up persistently with clients to prevent delays while maintaining a professional, friendly tone.
  • Coordinate offer extensions, pre-boarding paperwork, and candidate logistics.

Client Success & Retention

  • Conduct 30/60/90-day check-ins post-placement to ensure alignment and satisfaction.
  • Monitor and escalate client issues before they become critical.
  • Identify growth opportunities within accounts, including additional headcount or new roles.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding with clients and internal operations (Miya).

Internal Coordination & Process Improvement

  • Align daily with Recruitment and Operations teams on client priorities and feedback.
  • Maintain accurate records in Monday.com, Workable, and internal CRM/ATS.
  • Contribute to refining client-facing SOPs and playbooks.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience in Client Account Management, Recruitment Account Management, or B2B Customer Success.
    • Proven ability to manage multiple clients and processes simultaneously.
    • Experience working with U.S. start ups
    • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (native/bilingual level).
    • Comfortable using CRM/ATS/Collaboration tools (Workable, Monday.com, Slack, Zoom/Fathom).
    • Ability to work full U.S. Central or Pacific time zones reliably.
    • Ability to work reliably and independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision.
    • Bachelor Degree or higher (summa, magna or cum laude and/or Academic Scholar from a reputable college preferred)
  • Preferred Requirements
    • Experience managing recruitment pipelines in a remote staffing or BPO environment.
    • Familiarity with U.S. startup culture, particularly Series B/C companies.
    • Bonus: Experience with ATS or CRM integrations, scaling client delivery processes.

Benefits

At Anavah Talent, we’re all about helping you find your God-given space at a U.S. Company. And, we know work is more than just a paycheck, which is why we support work-life balance, well-being, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to as part of the Anavah Talent Community!

  • Competitive Compensation – We recognize your skills and experience with a great compensation package.
  • Regular Payday in USD – Twice per month, we send USD right to your bank account.
  • Work Remotely, Forever - Save on the commute and work from home, wherever that is in the world.
  • Milestone Gifts & Birthday Treats – We celebrate your achievements and make your special day even better!
  • Exciting Team Experiences – Think team offsites, meetups, virtual town halls, and even international paid travel.
  • Stay Connected – Be part of a supportive network where you can learn, grow, and connect with amazing people.
  • Global Networking - Work with top international teams across 12 countries around the world.
  • Mentorship, Advocacy and Support - We stay in the room and advocate for you every step of the way.
  • Promotions and Increases - Perform and earn more with raises, promotions, and scope-increases.

This is a remote position.

KATBOTZ LLC is seeking an experiencedSAP PMO Leadto establish and manage Project Management Office (PMO) functions forSAP GROW (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition)transformation programs. The ideal candidate will be responsible for program governance, project controls, reporting, resource tracking, risk management, financial oversight, and ensuring delivery excellence across multiple SAP Cloud ERP projects.

This role will work closely with Program Managers, Project Managers, Executive Sponsors, SAP Consultants, and client stakeholders to provide visibility, consistency, and governance throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
PMO Governance & Controls

  • Establish and maintain PMO governance frameworks for SAP GROW implementation programs.

  • Define project management standards, templates, reporting structures, and governance processes.

  • Ensure adherence to SAP Activate methodology, project controls, and delivery standards.

  • Monitor project compliance, quality metrics, and governance requirements.

  • Support portfolio management and project prioritization activities.

Program Reporting & Executive Communications

  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, project status reports, KPI tracking, and governance documentation.

  • Prepare steering committee materials, executive presentations, and leadership updates.

  • Consolidate reporting across multiple projects, workstreams, and stakeholders.

  • Provide visibility into program health, risks, issues, budget performance, and resource utilization.

  • Facilitate governance meetings and action tracking.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, actuals, and financial performance.

  • Track resource allocation, utilization, demand planning, and capacity management.

  • Support project managers with budget controls and financial reporting.

  • Identify resource constraints and coordinate staffing requirements across programs.

  • Assist with vendor management and contract tracking activities.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Maintain centralized risk, issue, decision, and dependency logs.

  • Monitor mitigation plans and ensure timely resolution of critical items.

  • Escalate program-level concerns and provide recommendations for resolution.

  • Support project audits, health checks, and governance reviews.

SAP GROW Program Support

  • Support planning and execution of SAP GROW implementation projects.

  • Coordinate activities across functional, technical, integration, data migration, testing, and change management teams.

  • Ensure project milestones, deliverables, and governance requirements are achieved.

  • Promote best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, Finance, or related field.

  • 10+ years of PMO, project governance, program management, or project controls experience.

  • Experience supporting ERP transformation or enterprise software implementation programs.

  • Strong experience with:

    • PMO Governance

    • Project Reporting

    • Budget Tracking

    • Resource Management

    • Risk & Issue Management

    • Executive Communications

    • Portfolio Management

  • Advanced skills in project management and reporting tools.

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SAP GROW or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition programs.

  • SAP Activate methodology knowledge.

  • PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PMOCP, or equivalent certification.

  • Experience with SAP implementation partners or consulting organizations.

  • Experience managing global or multi-country transformation programs.

  • Advanced expertise with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar PMO tools.

Required Skills

  • SAP GROW

  • PMO Leadership

  • Project Governance

  • SAP Activate

  • Program Reporting

  • Portfolio Management

  • Resource Planning

  • Financial Management

  • Risk & Issue Management

  • Executive Dashboards

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Continuous Improvement

Key Deliverables

  • PMO Governance Framework

  • Resource Utilization Reports

  • Budget and Financial Tracking Reports

  • Risk, Issue, and Dependency Logs

Benefits
​

raw.title: National Account Manager - B2B Wine Sales
raw.excerpt: About us:In a nutshell, we’re all about making great wine better, for everyone.
raw.description:
About us:

In a nutshell, we’re all about making great wine better, for everyone. We partner directly with the world’s best independent winemakers to bring our members better-quality wine for a better price. No thirsty middlemen as far as the eye can see.

It’s a different way of doing things, sure. But it works. We’re one of the US’ favorite wine clubs, shipping over 1 million (!) cases a year to curious wine lovers. And with an ambitious road ahead, we’ve got no plans on plugging the cork on growth.

Our global team (we have offices in the UK and Australia, too) is entrepreneurial by nature, obsessive about customer experience and driven by performance. All things that make Naked a great place to grow both personally and professionally. And yes, we like wine. A lot – we even have a wine fridge in the office.

The opportunity:

It takes a village to run Naked. That’s why we’re always on the lookout for eager talent to join the bunch. And now, our B2B team is looking for a new Commercial Wine Sales Manager to be part of the fun.

So if you’re excited to help us connect more wine lovers with talented winemakers, there’s a Naked welcome pack with your name on it.

Together, we’ll take Naked Wines to the next level – and share our not-so-well-kept secret with the world.

Location & flexible working: Remote, but must reside in the state of California for employer tax purposes.

What you'll do:

Cultivate B2B Partnerships: Proactively identify, engage, and secure high-volume corporate accounts, with a focus on major US retail groups, grocery chains, and regional wine shop networks.

  • Manage Complex Contracts: Pitch, negotiate, and finalize complex Private Label and Controlled Label wine agreements, ensuring win-win commercial terms for all parties.
  • Expand Market Reach: Maximize our portfolio placement across multiple channels by leveraging and growing a strong network of retail buyers, industry brokers, and travel retail accounts like airlines and cruise ships.
  • Capitalize on Global Trends: Partner with the VP of B2B to refine our private labeling value proposition, identifying market gaps and capturing high-margin international opportunities.
  • Collaborate Internally: Work seamlessly with internal Buying, Planning, Winemaking, and Procurement teams to ensure newly closed transactions are executed accurately and efficiently.
  • Manage Your Pipeline: Autonomously oversee your sales pipeline from cold outreach to final execution, maintaining high organizational standards to meet timelines.

To nail your job you will:

  • Wine Industry Expertise: Extensive background in B2B wine sales, showcasing a clear record of closing high-volume commercial deals, particularly within the US or California markets.
  • Established Industry Network: A strong, reliable network of pre-existing contacts and relationships with corporate retail chain buyers, large-scale wine shops, and supermarkets.
  • Commercial Strategy: Sound knowledge of Private Labeling mechanics alongside an understanding of national distribution networks, compliance requirements, and import/export dynamics.
  • Collaborative Mindset: An entrepreneurial, proactive attitude with the capability to navigate ambiguity, solve problems, and build strong, cooperative working relationships.
  • Superb Communication: Exceptional presentation and relationship-management skills, especially when delivering pitches to Category Managers.
  • Operational Readiness: Proficiency with MS Office Suite or Google Workspace tools, a detail-oriented approach to office procedures, eligibility to work in the US, and a minimum age of 21.
  • Be responsible for upholding company mission, vision and values
  • Other tasks, duties or special projects as assigned

Requirements

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ years of extensive experience in B2B wine sales, with a primary focus on the US market and a verified, quantifiable track record of closing high-volume deals (California market experience is highly desired).
  • An active, gold-standard network of pre-existing contacts and established relationships with major wine buyers at corporate retail chains, supermarkets, and large-scale wine shops.
  • Commercial acumen, featuring solid knowledge of Private Labeling mechanics, with exposure to or a strong understanding of national distribution and import/export dynamics. Wine compliance understanding being a major plus.
  • A "hunter" mindset with a proven passion for sales negotiation and a history of independently driving complex deals across the finish line.
  • An entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude with the ability to navigate ambiguity and implement strategic solutions across different geographical markets.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills, capable during category manager pitches.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Skilled with MS office Suite (Word, Excel, PPT) and/or Google Workspaces.
  • Understanding of organizational goals, office procedures, policies and Employee Handbook
  • Proof of eligibility to work in the US.
  • Ability to analyze situations and implement solutions independently.
  • Ability to work cooperatively and establish and maintain effective work relationships while performing duties.
  • Ability to organize work to meet deadlines.

The Naked values you’ll live by:

  • We are Naked Together – our business is built on an ecosystem where we must all work together. Together we can go further than we can alone.
  • We back independence – we encourage independent thinking, from our employees, our winemakers, and our Angels (that’s what we call our members).
  • We are bold – we choose courage over comfort and are not afraid to do things differently. We have a spirit of pioneering and we like to dream big.
  • We care about our craft – we have a passion for our craft – from winemaking, to customer service, to finance, to technology. We strive for excellence in everything we do.
  • We choose what’s right – doing the right thing is a choice. There are inevitable trade-offs when deciding what is right. We never cut corners.

Recruitment process:

Recruiter Chat (30 min)

A friendly conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your sales experience and what excites you about Naked.

Round 1 Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)
A deeper dive into your private label market experience and network connections within the B2B industry with Hady Kahale, VP B2B Sales

Round 2 Panel Interview (45 min)

You’ll meet our Senior Legal Counsel and Finance Director of Global Operations OR the Chief Operations Officer and Wine Director

Round 3- Final Interview (30 min)

You'll meet with our Chief Financial Officer

Benefits

Your benefits (the juicy part):

As part of the Naked family, we want you to know we've got your back. Here are a few of the perks you'll enjoy when you join the team…

  • Annual Bonus
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance – 90% employee coverage, 60% dependent coverage. Eligible from day 1.
  • Holiday allowance – 34 days of paid time off, including 20 days of accrued paid time off (PTO) and 12 paid company holidays. Paid time off also includes your Birthday, plus one additional day for volunteer efforts.
  • Retirement plan – 4% employer match. Eligible from day 1.
  • Wine allowance – $40 a month towards your Nakedwines.com account
  • Gym contribution – Up to $25 a month towards a gym membership
  • Personal Pathways – Naked will pay up to $500 annually towards training on any topic you may be interested in pursuing (doesn't have to be work-related)
  • Company Share Plan

Overview

GPM Empire, LLC is hiring a Staff Attorney to support its in-house legal team on the commercial and contract matters that drive GPM's wholesale fuel distribution and fleet fueling operations. The Staff Attorney will process buyout requests and terminations of wholesale customer agreements, draft and review correspondence, ancillary transaction documents, and other contract-related materials (including amendments, consents, and notices), maintain the contracts and matter tracker with regular status reporting to the Deputy General Counsel and senior leadership, review and improve standard form agreements such as supply, consignment, and lease templates, and identify process improvements that increase efficiency in contract intake, drafting turnaround, and legal support for operational teams. The ideal candidate has 2-5 years of transactional or corporate legal experience and is looking for the autonomy and cross-functional exposure that comes with an in-house role at a growing, operationally driven company. This position will report to the Deputy General Counsel.

This position is remote-eligible, with a hybrid arrangement available for candidates near GPM’s Richmond, VA or Dallas, TX offices. Occasional travel and in-person attendance may be required based on business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Process buyout requests and terminations of wholesale customer agreements
  • Draft and review correspondence, ancillary transaction documents, and other contract-related materials, including amendments, consents, and notices
  • Maintain and update the contracts and matter tracker, providing regular status reports to the Deputy General Counsel and senior leadership
  • Review and improve standard form agreements (including supply, consignment, and lease templates) based on business feedback, negotiation trends, and lessons learned from prior transactions
  • Identify process improvements to increase efficiency in contract intake, drafting turnaround, and legal support for operational teams
  • Perform other related duties as assigned, consistent with the position’s responsibilities

Qualifications

  • Solid analytical/logical mindset and attention to detail
  • Strong written/verbal communication skills (clear, concise, and confident), along with the ability to communicate effectively with others at all levels of the organization
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters
  • Self-motivated and able to prioritize under tight time constraints
  • Ability to work both autonomously and in a team setting
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with non-legal teams such as Operations, Fuel, Logistics, Real Estate, Credit, and Risk Management
  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, with familiarity in supply, distribution, lease, or M&A transactions preferred
  • Juris Doctorate
  • Active bar membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state (admission in one or more of the following jurisdictions preferred: Virginia or Texas)
  • 2-5 years of transactional or corporate legal experience, in-house or at a law firm
  • Familiarity with commercial contract law, UCC Article 2 and Article 9 principles, and standard secured transaction and M&A documentation

GPM Investments, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment and personnel practices on the basis of race, sex, age, disability, religion, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Unlawful discrimination will not be a factor in any employment decision.

raw.description:
Overview

Seismic is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to advance reliability across our AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, and OCI environments, working hands-on to build automation, improve observability, and strengthen incident response as part of a globally distributed SRE org. We prioritize a cloud agnostic approach to architecture, automation, and engineering standards to support velocity and scale. You will contribute to our reliability roadmap, provide technical guidance on reliability best practices, participate in major incident response, and work collaboratively across Product & Engineering, Security, and Customer-facing teams.

Who you are:

  • Experience in a production facing SRE role supporting a complex SaaS environment.
  • You approach discussions about existing solutions, processes, and proposals with curiosity, respect, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, multi-cloud environments, Kubernetes, networking, various infrastructure technologies, GitOps, and CI/CD.
  • Experience establishing and maturing SRE principles and practices, including SLOs, error budgets, observability, capacity planning, incident response, and toil elimination.
  • Proficient in using observability data to resolve high-severity incidents and dig deeper into root cause during postmortems.
  • Experience leading through high-pressure incidents and communicating clearly with technical teams, executives, customer-facing stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

What you'll be doing:

Operating Model

  • Design, build, and maintain automation and tooling that reduces operational toil.
  • Contribute to maturing reliability practices in partnership with Product & Engineering leaders.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, high-accountability culture that encourages curiosity, collaboration, and blameless improvement.

Incident Management and Operational Excellence

  • Actively participate in the health and continuous improvement of the incident-management lifecycle, including detection, engagement, escalation, mitigation, stakeholder communication, post-incident review, and corrective-action follow-through.
  • Participate in a 12-hour follow-the-sun on-call rotation within the Global SRE team.
  • Ensure incident practices are customer-centered, data-driven, blameless, and consistent across teams while preserving accurate severity and escalation decisions.
  • Use alert, incident, support, and SLO trends to move the organization from reactive response toward proactive risk reduction.
  • Build measurable feedback loops that connect incident learning to engineering standards, service maturity, product priorities, and vendor actions.
  • Work closely with application engineering teams and incorporate their feedback to improve developer experience and reduce toil.

Reliability Strategy and Service Maturity

  • Partner with service owners to ensure production readiness standards are met before each release stage.
  • Provide an SRE point of view on capacity planning, resilience testing, game days, disaster-recovery readiness, and modernization of fragile or legacy workloads.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to document critical customer workflows, define health expectations, surface dependencies early, and align reliability investment with business priorities.
  • Participate in cross-team reliability engagements, influencing outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • Build strategic relationships with vendors in the observability, incident response, and cloud infrastructure domains.

AI-First Reliability Engineering

  • Responsibly adopt AI-assisted and agentic workflows for alert triage, incident mitigation, postmortems, trend analysis, capacity planning, SLO analysis, and self-service knowledge.
  • Keep qualified humans in the decision loop for production-impacting actions.
  • Improve the context available to reliability workflows by strengthening service metadata, observability data, incident records, runbooks, architecture documentation, and corrective-action quality.

What we have for you:

At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.

Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.Seismic's annual base salary range for this position will vary based on applicant's location, experience, job level, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and alignment market data. The range listed below is the minimum to the maximum of our target hiring range. Seismic's salary range for this position is: USD $150,000.00/Yr. - USD $175,000.00/Yr.This position is also eligible to participate in Seismic's incentive plans in addition to base salary. The actual incentive amount will very and will be subject to the terms and conditions set in the applicable incentive plan.

Who We Are

Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business.

Work Shift

1 - First Shift

Job Summary

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and building solutions that support innovation and efficiency? As an IT Developer I, you’ll contribute to the low-code development and support of internal applications and AI Agents that improve and enhance enterprise productivity, streamline workflows, and deliver innovative digital experiences and processes across the business. Join a collaborative team where your foundational skills will grow into impactful contributions that support Vermeer’s mission of excellence and innovation.

What You’ll Do

1. Assist in the development, configuration, and maintenance of internal applications using the Microsoft Power Platform including PowerApps and Power Automate.

2. Support integration efforts by working with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and relational databases to ensure seamless data flow across systems.

3. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning and story pointing, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver incremental value.

4. Contribute to the creation of automated test cases to support software quality and reduce manual testing efforts.

5. Develop, deploy, and maintain AI agents using platforms such as Copilot Studio, integrating them with enterprise applications and data sources.

  3. définition des besoins

  • Accompagner les gestionnaires dans la définition de la vision d’affaires et des orientations stratégiques;

  • Estimer les coûts, efforts et échéanciers et définir les stratégies de réalisation des initiatives;
  • Diriger ou structurer les travaux d’analyse dans un contexte où les livrables sont réalisés en mode forfaitaire, nécessitant une maîtrise des efforts et des livraisons;
  • Participer activement aux activités de gouvernance, coordination et suivi des mandats, incluant la gestion des parties prenantes;
  • Assurer un transfert de connaissances structuré auprès des équipes internes;
  • Produire l’ensemble des livrables attendus conformément aux standards organisationnels et assurer leur qualité jusqu’à leur approbation;

Requirements

  • Minimum 12 ans d’expérience en TI / affaires
  • Minimum 8 ans comme architecte d’affaires sénior

  • Expérience en organisation d’envergure (public, assurance, banque, etc.)
  • Forte expertise en :
  1. Architecture d’affaires
  2. Transformation numérique
  3. Gouvernance et décision stratégique
  • Capacité à livrer en mode forfaitaire (risque maître sur effort réel)

Benefits

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

raw.description:
introduction

IAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud. We are a fully employee owned, bootstrapped company - which means we answer to our customers and our team, not investors. With around 35 employees, we serve more than 3,000 organisations worldwide.

Being employee owned shapes how we work. Decisions are long-term, the culture is collaborative, and the people who build the company share in its success. We have leaned deliberately into AI and agentic workflows across the business as a core part of how a focused team competes with companies ten times our size. We are fully remote with employees in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Argentina and have been remote for years, as a deliberate choice about how good work gets done.

about the role

Role Overview
Reporting to the CIO, you will own, lead and grow the IAM Cloud Support Desk - the front line of contact for customer product support, and in time, for our internal IT also. You’ll be responsible for the oversight of all Desk operations and ensuring efficient, professional and consistent resolution of incoming incidents, issues and queries. You’ll bring demonstrable leadership experience, having led and grown comparable teams, ideally for a similar SaaS provider.

Initially, you’ll be focused on our existing Customer Support desk, handling incoming customer contact.

Responsibilities include:

  • Defining and embedding best practices for Support Desk operations; ticket handling, categorisation, prioritisation, routing, escalation, and closure
  • Driving functional performance through appropriate use of metrics, root-cause analysis and backlog management
  • Foster a continuous learning environment; ensuring knowledge gained from issues and product investigations improves Support through documentation, runbooks and training
  • Optimising the use of our tooling suite, ensuring usage and configuration best practice
  • Coaching, mentoring and performance managing our Technical Support Engineers
  • Working closely with our internal teams to close feedback loops, improve product quality, and reduce recurrence of issues
  • Acting as senior escalation point, owning communications during incidents and major issues
  • Championing a customer-first mindset and striving to create a Centre of Excellence in Support
  • Ensuring the Support Desk remains compliant with data protection responsibilities and Information Security requirements
Within six months, your scope will expand to the management of the internal IT function and technical accountability for the IT estate, with responsibilities including:
  • Delivery of the end-user computing estate: ensuring corporate devices and applications are correctly provisioned, maintained, supported and managed throughout their lifecycle
  • Administration of the Microsoft 365 environment, ensuring configuration remains secure, supportable and aligned with Microsoft best practice
  • Ownership of endpoint and remote-management capabilities; defining and maintaining policies, configuration standards, patching controls and monitoring
  • Maintaining IT asset and software-management controls, ensuring accurate lifecycle records across the technology estate
  • Providing support for the security of the end-user computing and Microsoft 365 environments to ensure appropriate security controls, endpoint protection, monitoring and incident remediation

what we're looking for

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Proven experience: you can demonstrate (at least 3 years) leading a busy Support Desk, Helpdesk or cross-functional technical support team, preferably in a SaaS environment
  • Technical aptitude: you must be comfortable leading a team in support of complex software products, and delivery of internal IT. You will likely have a technical administrative or IT operations background prior to your leadership roles
  • Industry competence: you’re an expert navigator within the Microsoft ecosystem; we develop MS-adjacent products so knowledge of 365, SharePoint, OneDrive and Graph are all high value
  • Hands-on attitude: you like to roll your sleeves up and pitch in with the workload, and consider yourself a player-manager
  • Performance management: you have demonstrable experience defining and working to SLAs, KPIs and functional metrics (e.g. response times, resolution times, backlog, customer satisfaction)
  • Leadership: you’ve managed and grown successful Support teams previously, and understand the demands of people management responsibilities
  • Tooling: you’re familiar with the use and optimisation of support & ticketing systems / ITSM tools
  • Collaboration: you possess strong stakeholder and cross-functional collaboration skills to manage the high expectations of our customers and internal functions
  • Mindset: you possess a proactive and dynamic mindset; able to manage ambiguity, prioritise under pressure and adapt quickly
  • Quality-driven: you always show a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence

why us?

Guaranteed £2,000 (or local equivalent) pay rise every year you're with us, separate from any merit or promotion increases.

Time off and flexibility

  • 26 days holiday plus public holidays, with the option to swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.
  • Your birthday and work anniversary day off, every year.
  • Up to 4 weeks per year working from anywhere in the world.
  • Genuinely flexible, fully remote working - we trust you to manage your own time.

Health, family, and wellbeing (UK employees)

  • Generous Becoming a Parent leave, designed to support every kind of family.
  • Medical scheme including remote GP, dental, optical, and diagnostics.
  • Access to Support Room - confidential counselling, therapy, and coaching.
  • Help@Hand employee assistance programme.
  • 5x salary life insurance through Unum.

Money and growth

  • Up to 10% pension match. (UK employees)
  • Annual learning and development budget per function.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

raw.description:
Overview

Location: Fully Remote (Milwaukee, WI)

Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire

Are you a senior-level software engineer who enjoys solving complex integration challenges while building scalable enterprise applications? Trissential is hiring a Senior PHP Software Engineer to join our client's team. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact eCommerce and ERP integrations, contribute across the full application stack, and play a key role in driving enterprise technology solutions that directly support business growth.

What's in It for You?

  • Work on mission-critical enterprise integrations connecting eCommerce, ERP, and internal business systems
  • Leverage modern integration technologies including Boomi, REST APIs, and enterprise middleware solutions
  • Make a measurable impact by improving application performance, reliability, and scalability
  • Collaborate with technical leaders, business stakeholders, and vendors on innovative enterprise solutions
  • Mentor and support fellow engineers while expanding your own leadership capabilities
  • Enjoy a fully remote work environment while contributing to large-scale technology initiatives
  • Participate in Agile development teams focused on continuous improvement and innovation

Your Role & Responsibilities

Enterprise Integrations & APIs

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between eCommerce platforms, ERP systems, and internal applications
  • Build and support RESTful APIs and enterprise data exchange processes
  • Manage data synchronization, transformation, validation, and interoperability across multiple systems
  • Lead complex integration initiatives involving OroCommerce, IFS ERP, and third-party platforms
  • Serve as a technical expert for integration architecture and API development
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration design and implementation challenges
  • Promote reliable, scalable, and maintainable integration practices across the organization

Application Development

  • Support, enhance, and customize OroCommerce applications using PHP and Symfony
  • Contribute across both front-end and back-end development initiatives
  • Develop enterprise applications using PHP, Oracle PL/SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ensure applications meet performance, security, scalability, and maintainability standards
  • Conduct code reviews and provide technical feedback to improve software quality
  • Coach and mentor junior and mid-level developers
  • Champion software engineering best practices and coding standards

Production Support & Reliability

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise applications and integrations
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions
  • Support deployments and ensure successful release management activities
  • Lead investigation and resolution of complex production incidents
  • Improve monitoring, performance optimization, and operational processes
  • Participate throughout the SDLC including development, testing, deployment, and support

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to deliver successful solutions
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and backlog refinement
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for integrations, applications, and workflows
  • Assist with project estimation, technical analysis, and architecture discussions
  • Share technical knowledge through mentoring, reviews, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across development and support teams

Skills & Experience You Should Possess

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with both front-end and back-end development
  • Strong expertise in PHP development, ideally within Symfony-based environments
  • Experience developing and supporting REST APIs and enterprise integrations
  • Experience working with integration platforms such as Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, or similar technologies
  • Advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development experience
  • Experience supporting production systems and resolving complex application issues
  • Strong understanding of JSON, OAuth, system interoperability, and integration patterns
  • Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on experience with OroCommerce development and customization
  • Experience integrating with IFS ERP environments
  • Expertise designing enterprise-scale Boomi integrations
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Background supporting eCommerce technology ecosystems
  • Experience leading integration modernization initiatives

Education & Certifications You Need

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Relevant integration, cloud, or software engineering certifications are a plus

What We Offer

At Trissential, we believe exceptional professionals deserve meaningful work, strong support, and opportunities to continue growing. By joining our client's team, you'll collaborate with talented professionals while working on enterprise-scale technology initiatives

  • Competitive Compensation – $68–$73 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on skill alignment, years of experience, and fair, market-based rates by geography
  • Comprehensive Benefits for you and your dependents – Extensive Medical Plans, Dental, Vision, HSA with company contribution, company sponsored Life Insurance and Short / Long term disability insurance, a host of voluntary plans including legal, hospital, accident, pet wellness, and 401k with matching
  • Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off
  • Career Development and Advancement – Expleo is a global company in 29 Countries worldwide with a high focus on development
  • Strong Team Culture – Collaborate with experienced professionals who value precision, performance, and teamwork

Please note: This role is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States

Ready to be part of something exciting?

If you're passionate about enterprise integrations, modern application development, and solving complex technical challenges, we want to hear from you. Join Trissential and help shape the future of enterprise technology solutions while advancing your career as a Senior PHP Software Engineer

raw.title: Web Developer (Contractors)
raw.excerpt: About KadinceKadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013.
raw.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

Why We’re Looking for Contractors

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re dedicated to giving each customer the best experience possible, which means having enough people to take care of all their needs. We’re growing quickly and so are the needs of our customers. That’s why we’re looking for contractors in Brazil to help with our development needs, work on full-stack projects, and interact with our team in the US.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a web development contractor at Kadince you should have at least 1 year of work experience. This experience has given you an understanding of basic database-driven web applications and a proficient knowledge of the MVC pattern.

You’re able to adapt quickly to new environments, are organized and focused, can look beyond current constraints, and can provide solutions to complex problems. Simply put, we need a problem solver, not just someone who completes as many tasks as possible.

Even though you'll be working remotely from Brazil, you’ll be joining projects that may involve interactions with our US-based development team. So a strong level of English communication is important. This will make it possible to participate in occasional meetings to discuss project progress.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our dev team (hopefully you are), you probably want to know more about our tech stack. Outside of our dev team, we’re not really sure what most of this means, but we sure hope you do.

Technologies/Frameworks

  • Ruby on Rails
  • GraphQL
  • Postgres
  • Redis
  • ReactJS
  • Minitest
  • Cypress

DevOps

  • Kubernetes
  • Helm
  • Docker
  • CircleCI

Other Tools

  • Jira
  • Rubymine
  • Sentry
  • Logrocket
  • Wooly Bugger

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  • Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  • Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  • Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  • Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

These core values should resonate with you. Even our contractors are expected to provide work that demonstrates these values.

What You’d Work On

As a contractor, you’ll work on various projects with the Kadince development team. Here are examples of projects you may find yourself working on:

  • Software bugs
  • Feature enhancements
  • Feature creation

You’ll work with your Kadince contact to get assignments, complete projects, and receive feedback. We’re always open to feedback and suggestions, so if you ever see areas of improvement or ways we might make your job easier, please let us know.

Flexibility

At Kadince, we understand that flexibility is crucial, especially for contractors. We offer the freedom to work remotely from anywhere, allowing you to set up a work environment that fits your personal and professional needs. Our team is distributed and accustomed to asynchronous communication, which means that even though you'll have to communicate with our US-based team, your schedule can remain flexible to accommodate your availability and your time zone.

Compensation

At Kadince, we offer compensation above typical rates in the Brazilian market, paid in USD—an exciting opportunity to work with a global team and gain valuable international experience. Here’s what you can expect based on your level of experience and expertise:

  • Tier 1: Entry Level (1-2 years of experience): $5-$10/hour – A solid foundation to kickstart your career and make meaningful contributions.
  • Tier 2: Mid Level (2-5 years of experience): $10-$15/hour – Recognizing your growing expertise and ability to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Tier 3: Senior Level (5+ years of experience): $15-$20/hour – Rewarding your advanced skills, leadership, and significant contributions.

* These ranges represent an initial offer based on your experience, technical skills, and English communication level. As you consistently deliver excellent work, there may be opportunities to align your compensation with your growing contribution to the projects.

How to Apply

Applicants who stand out are those who are interested in working with Kadince. We’ve seen it all. No kidding, we once had someone ask us in an interview what the name of our company is. Needless to say, we could tell that person wasn’t really passionate about joining our team.

When applying to Kadince, please send us PDFs of your resume and cover letter. The cover letter is your opportunity to tell us why we should choose to work with you but should be no longer than 300 words. Take advantage of this time. Seriously, sell yourself!

Thank you for your interest in Kadince. We look forward to reviewing your application.

* This position is open to candidates living in Brazil.

Salary: $5 -$20 per hour (initial offer)

raw.excerpt: Who We AreJoin a team that puts its People First!
raw.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of the First American family of companies, First American Trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full-service basis for more than five decades. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

First American Trust is seeking an experienced Senior Scrum Master to help agile teams deliver meaningful business outcomes through effective Lean-Agile practices.

The Senior Scrum Master is a senior agile practitioner who serves as a servant leader, coach, facilitator, and change agent. This role helps teams improve effectiveness, delivery flow, transparency, and predictability while supporting First American Trust’s business agility roadmap.

The Senior Scrum Master works closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, leaders, stakeholders, Release Train Engineer and other Senior Scrum Masters to strengthen Agile practices, remove systemic barriers, and improve how work moves from concept to customer value.

What You'll Do:

  • Facilitate and drive effective Scrum and Agile events, including dailysync, backlog refinement,iterationplanning,iterationreviews, and retrospectives.

  • Ensure events are purposeful, well prepared, inclusive, and result in clear decisions, actions, or improvement commitments.

  • Coach teams in Scrum, Kanban, Lean-Agile principles, self-organization, collaboration, continuous improvement, and effective delivery practices.

  • Build a safe, trusting, and inclusive team environment where concerns can be raised openly and addressed through problem solving.

  • Partner with Product Owners to improve backlog health, prioritization, refinement, sprint readiness,PI Planning readinessand alignment to customer and business outcomes.

  • Help teamsestablishmeaningful sprint goals and improve delivery predictability, quality, flow, and accountability.

  • Independentlyidentify, understand, track, escalate, and help remove impediments, risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers.

  • Lead structured problem-solving conversations that help teams and stakeholders address the causesof delivery challenges.

  • Protect the team from unnecessary interruptions whilemaintainingappropriate transparencywith stakeholders and leadership.

  • Use Jira and other Agile tools tomaintainaccuratedelivery information and communicate relevant metrics, trends, risks, dependencies, and progress.

  • Usedeliverymetrics to support transparency, learning, and improvement rather than individual performance evaluation.

  • Facilitate retrospectives that produce meaningful, documented improvement actions andcoach team tofollow through on those commitments.

  • Coordinate with engineering leaders, managers, architects, business partners, and other Scrum Masters to resolve cross-team challenges.

  • Represent the team inCoach Sync, ART Sync, and otherART-level coordination events.

  • Help teams prepare for andparticipateeffectively in PI Planning, including readiness, planning inputs,objectives, dependencies, risks, and commitments.

  • Collaborate with other Senior Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners to share effective practices, lessons learned, facilitation techniques, and approaches for improving team and organizational agility.

  • Contribute to the Lean-Agile Office’s business agility roadmap and the continued evolution of First American Trust’s Agile operating model.

  • Demonstrate servant leadership, situationalawareness, emotionalintelligenceadaptability, anda growthmindset.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5-7years of experience applying Scrum and Agile methodsas scrum master of an agile software delivery team.

  • Prefer 1-2 years of experience in the Scaled Agile Framework.

  • Experience coachingAgileteams across different team sizes, levels of maturity, and delivery contexts.

  • Strong knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, Lean-Agile principles, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead Scrum events and create environments that promote participation, accountability, transparency, and psychological safety.

  • Experience coaching teams and Product Owners on Agile practices, backlog health, collaboration, and delivery effectiveness.

  • Demonstrated ability toidentify, escalate, and resolve impediments, delivery risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers.

  • Strong understanding of backlog management, prioritization, refinement, sprint planning, sprint goals, and outcome-based delivery.

  • Moderate toexpert-level experience with Jira or comparable Agile delivery tools.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical audiences and senior leadership.

  • Strong facilitation, conflict-resolution, negotiation,stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to influence without formal authority and work effectively in a cross-functional, fast-moving environment.

  • Certified ScrumMasterorSAFeAdvanced Scrum Master certificationisrequired.

  • Bachelor’sdegree in Business, Information Technology, or related fields.

Pay Range: $112,400.00 - $149,800.00 AnnuallyThis hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

** Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. **

First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act).

First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

Remote Scheduling Coordinator

Do you enjoy helping patient’s access important healthcare services?

Are you a problem solver? Detail oriented? Great communicator?

If so, you may be just what we’re looking for!

About the Position

This position is responsible for providing excellent customer service to patients and physician offices in order to coordinate the scheduling and completion of diagnostic sleep testing.

Primary duties consist of:

  • HEAVY PHONE WORK - Inbound and outbound calls
  • Schedule a minimum of 20 patients per day (required very heavy outbound phone work)
  • Obtains patient history and all appropriate clinical data prior to appointment
  • Educates patients regarding the type of sleep testing ordered, the registration and study process, and additional services available
  • Verify insurance (online) prior to scheduling to ensure compliant billing
  • Communicates and works with clinical team to ensure appropriate staff availability to meet patient needs and access to services
  • Interacts with physicians, insurance providers, and others to address and resolve a variety of issues and concerns
  • Reports weekly and monthly information pertinent to assigned sites
  • Other duties as assigned

Education and Experience:

  • 1+ year customer service experience
  • Experience in a medical setting preferred
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Strong multitasking skills between task lists and inbound calls
  • Strong computer skills: Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new software quickly
  • High level of organization and accuracy
  • Exceptional telephone communication skills and manner, reflecting enthusiasm and professionalism

**This position requires the ability to work 1 weekend day and 1 evening shift per month**

**Remote environment must provide privacy, with secure password protected internet access and no other concurrent responsibilities during scheduled work hours**

About Neurocare

Neurocare, Inc., is the largest employer of Sleep Technologists in the New England area for over 25 years. We are a patient-centric, quality-focused organization. We collaborate with high profile academic medical centers, community hospitals, and physician groups to design and manage state of the art sleep disorder programs. Our strong commitment to uncompromising quality care and customer service has driven our reputation as a leader in the field.

Neurocare, Inc. EOE

raw.title: Scrum Master (Information Technology/Software/Remote)
raw.excerpt: Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc).
raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;

title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
description: Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology.

raw.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
raw.excerpt: Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology.
raw.description:
Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers' document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline.

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You'll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there's room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software.

What You'll Engage In

  • Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters.
  • Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do.
  • Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success.
  • Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output.
  • Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations.
  • Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse.
  • Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm's data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works.
  • Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away.
  • Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting.
  • Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early

What You're Likely to Bring

Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems.

AI Fluency

  • ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports.
  • Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers.
  • Healthy skepticism. You verify what AI tells you, recognize when it is confidently wrong, and never let it replace your own judgment about risk.
  • An understanding of how to test systems that don't always give the same answer, such as AI features, by using repeated trials, sample sets, and "is this answer right?" checks rather than exact matches.
  • Careful handling of data. You use synthetic or masked data with AI tools and never paste customer or court data into unapproved services.

Technical Proficiency

· Comfort with the command line, Git, and reading logs. Some experience with Docker or Kubernetes (such as port-forwarding or checking pod logs) is a plus.

· Experience with defect tracking and test management in Jira.

How You Work

  • Analytical Mindset: Sharp attention to detail, curiosity, and a methodical approach to breaking software and finding root causes.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong written and verbal communication for bug reports, test notes, and status updates. Your reports are precise enough that another person, or an AI agent, can pick them up and act.
  • Ownership: When something seems "untestable," you find a way, whether that's a query, a log search, a simulator, or a question to the right engineer, rather than skipping it.

Requirements

  • Experience writing or maintaining automated tests (for example Playwright, Selenium, or API test scripts), including building them with AI and reviewing and fixing what it produces.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM features, such as checking classification accuracy, spotting hallucinations, or testing for prompt injection.
  • SQL skills for checking data in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience testing APIs directly with tools like Postman, curl, or Bruno, and an understanding of HTTP, REST, and JSON.
  • Experience with web security testing, including authentication and sessions, roles and permissions, OAuth2/SAML, CSRF, and XSS.
  • Experience using AI browser tools (for example Playwright MCP or browser agents) to speed up exploratory testing.
  • Experience testing integrations with third-party systems, email-driven workflows, or browser automation against external sites.
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Knowledge of the legal domain, especially court e-filing, docketing, or legal document management.
  • ISTQB or a similar QA certification.
  • An understanding of or experience with the Lean Startup approach.

Why QA Engineers Like It Here

  • Modern Tooling: Company-provided AI tools, with clear guidelines for using them safely.
  • Real Impact: You'll shape how we test in an AI-assisted team, not follow a fixed script.
  • AI in Production: Hands-on work testing real AI features used by law firms every day.

Benefits

  • Remote Flexibility: A fully remote role open to every US time zone, Hawaii included.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Flexible working hours and a supportive approach to getting work done.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: A range of insurance options covering health, dental, vision, and life.
  • Discretionary Time Off: We know a healthy work-life balance matters. Our discretionary time off (DTO) policy means that, on top of scheduled vacations and holidays, employees can take unplanned time off when needed, with supervisor approval. Life happens, and we trust our team to manage their time well.
  • Employee Stock Options: The opportunity to participate in the company stock option plan.

The Academic Program Director (PD) for Site-Based Learning Partnership (SBLP), is a key leadership position spanning both Capella and Strayer university; he/she/they promote and support a quality academic experience for learners by ensuring a site-based learning (SBL) experience that facilitates accreditation compliance and achievement of program outcomes. This management position contributes to a range of activities related to excellence in SBL effectiveness, learner success, satisfaction and engagement. work closely with deans, assistant/associate deans, program/faculty directors, as well as relevant university departments, to manage systems and processes related to SBL design and delivery. He/she/they coordinate with the Site-Based Learning and Services team, Portfolio, and relevant academic leaders to remain aware of issues related to student placement needs.

Clinical Placement — Demonstrates the ability to:

Leadership

Builds alignment through listening, partnership, and informed decision-making while independently advancing initiatives in support of organizational goals and priorities.

Creativity and alternative thinking to develop new ideas for and answers to work-related problems.

Accepting constructive criticism and dealing with high-stress situations.

raw.excerpt: AIR is seeking a Technical Assistance Consultant to join AIR’s Healthcare Innovations program, which focuses on supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Innovation Center in implementing and evaluating payment models.
raw.description:
AIR is seeking a Technical Assistance Consultant to join AIR’s Healthcare Innovations program, which focuses on supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Innovation Center in implementing and evaluating payment models. This specific position will support AIR’s work to provide technical assistance to states, providers, or other entities that participate in the payment models. The work involves a combination of designing and conducting technical assistance activities and resources, as well as developing communications to support information sharing through a variety of modalities.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

  • Identifying, assessing, and tracking the technical assistance needs of program participants.
  • Creating plans to address technical assistance needs.
  • Applying subject matter expertise or policy translation related to the program to develop technical assistance resources, including: memos, tipsheets, factsheets, checklists, templates, policy or review guides, frequently asked questions, and case studies.
  • Developing, hosting, or supporting webinars and office hours.
  • Designing communications for a variety of audiences and modalities.
  • Documenting technical assistance processes and procedures.
  • Facilitating discussions with program participants to identify participants’ progress toward program milestones, develop strategies and guidance to ensure participant success, and synthesize common themes across participant discussions.
  • Leading meetings and presenting information to team members and clients· Managing content within an online collaboration website to support program participants (e.g., resource library management, chatter posts).
  • Compiling and interpreting engagement metrics related to program activities and communications.
  • Managing content within an online collaboration website to support program participants (e.g., resource library management, chatter posts).

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree and 6 or more years of experience; Master's Degree and 4 or more years of experience; Doctoral Degree.
  • Experience designing and conducting technical assistance activities and resources, such as briefs, guides, toolkits and webinars for a variety of audiences.
  • Experience developing communications for newsletters, online collaboration sites, and public-facing websites.
  • Experience with qualitative data collection and analysis, such as for online surveys and interviews.
  • Experience translating policy into practical and actionable information for various audiences.
  • Experience delivering technical assistance for Medicaid programs and/or state Medicaid offices.
  • Knowledge of and experience working with behavioral health practices and clinicians, including integrated care delivery.
  • Knowledge of health information technology at the provider level.

Skills

  • Strong commitment to improving instructional quality and student outcomes through the use of research-based practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for working with stakeholders at various levels and from a range of backgrounds.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to lead and collaborate effectively in both in-person and virtual environments.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Disclosures: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

American Institutes for Research is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law, including, but not limited to, actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type, and protective hairstyles such as braid, locs, and twists), creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition (e.g., cancer), sex, gender, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, civil union status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, or military or veteran status. AIR adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles and will therefore undergo reference and background checks. AIR maintains a drug-free work environment.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTICE: If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to Taliba Boone at or call 202.403.5000.

Fraudulent Job Scams Warning & Disclaimer: AIR is aware of individuals falsely presenting themselves as AIR representatives. Fraudulent job scams seek to extract sensitive information or money from victims. To protect yourself, please be aware that AIR recruitment will only email you from an “@air.org” domain. Please take extra caution while examining the email address, for example is correct and is not a legitimate AIR email address.
