The Work:


As an Inside Sales Representative, you will support the end-to-end sales process for standardized cyber security solutions for mid-market clients in the United States, from initial needs assessment through deal closure. You will collaborate with Mid-Market Account Success Management to support a smooth transition to delivery and client onboarding.

This is a digital-first sales role. You will identify and progress opportunities through digital and social channels, including LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, AI and generative AI tools. You will also coordinate with marketing teams to develop points of view, support multi-client campaigns and maintain a disciplined commercial pipeline.


  • Drive digital sales and opportunity identification: Identify and progress cyber security sales opportunities through digital and social channels, building a consistent pipeline of standardized solution opportunities across the U.S. mid-market.
  • Support end-to-end sales of standardized solutions: Own the sales process for straightforward, well-defined cyber security solutions, from initial needs assessment and solution positioning through commercial negotiation and deal closure.
  • Coordinate across marketing channels: Partner with marketing and campaign teams to create and share cyber security points of view, execute multi-client outreach and deliver consistent messaging to U.S. mid-market audiences.
  • Create client-facing content: Support the development of insight-led points of view, campaign content and client-facing collateral in partnership with cyber security subject matter experts and marketing teams.
  • Manage client contacts and communications: Maintain accurate records of client contacts, interaction history and pipeline status in Salesforce or an equivalent CRM, while ensuring timely and professional communications throughout the sales cycle.
  • Leverage AI and generative AI: Use AI-enabled tools to source opportunities, personalize outreach, accelerate research and progress opportunities efficiently.
  • Enable a smooth transition to delivery: Collaborate with Mid-Market Account Success Management to ensure a well-documented handoff from sale to onboarding.
  • Maintain pipeline accuracy and reporting: Own the accuracy of pipeline data, contact records and sales activity logs. Provide clear reporting on pipeline status, campaign performance and conversion metrics.

What’s In It for You:


  • Contribute to a high-growth cyber security initiative focused on the U.S. mid-market.

  • Develop toward career pathways in cyber sales, account management or marketing leadership.

  • Join a collaborative, high-energy team that values creativity, commercial focus and disciplined execution.

Travel may be required for role. 0-80% depending on client and business needs.


Here’s What You’ll Need:


  • 3+ years of experience in inside sales, digital sales or demand generation for technology, cloud or cyber security, with experience supporting standardized solutions from initial contact through close. Including hands-on experience with digital selling and social channels, including LinkedIn and Sales Navigator, and practical use of AI or generative AI tools to source, research and progress opportunities.
  • 3+ years strong CRM discipline, including maintaining accurate contact records, pipeline data and activity logs in Salesforce or an equivalent platform. 3+ years selling experience of contract value for $2 mn.
  • 3+ years engaging with potential clients and clearly articulating a value proposition.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate's degree, must have minimum 6 years' work experience).

Client Communications Director

The Director Client Communications leads the strategy and execution of Sedgwick's client communications, including virtual client events, client newsletters, and the client services newsroom. As a member of the Global Communication team in Marketing, this role ensures clients and the colleagues who support them receive clear, timely, accurate, and relatable information that builds trust and strengthens engagement. The Director captures the voice of the customer across client touchpoints and applies analytical rigor and marketing acumen to translate insights into content, communications strategy, and recommendations that support client engagement, satisfaction, retention, and growth.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE


  • Leads Sedgwick's client communications strategy and ensures messaging is consistent, clear, aligned with client needs, and reflective of the Sedgwick brand.
  • Champions the voice of the customer by translating complex claims, service, and operational information into client-facing content that is understandable, relevant, and useful.
  • Owns the content calendar and production of client newsletters and other recurring client communications, using client feedback and engagement data to refine topics, formats, channels, and cadence.
  • Partners with communications leadership and senior business leaders to identify client communication needs, priorities, risks, and opportunities across the client lifecycle.
  • Owns the planning, content development, and execution of virtual client events, webinars, briefings, and related post-event communications.
  • Partners with subject matter experts and senior leaders to develop event content, speaking materials, presentations, and supporting communications for client audiences.
  • Manages the client services newsroom and coordinates with Claims, Operations, Legal, Client Services, Marketing, and other business units to source, review, and publish accurate and timely content.
  • Establishes and implements governance, editorial, approval, and quality standards for newsroom and event content.
  • Captures the voice of the customer through virtual client events, newsletters, surveys, and other client touchpoints.
  • Analyzes feedback, attendance, engagement, and content performance information to identify trends, needs, opportunities, and gaps.
  • Translates findings into actionable recommendations that shape future client communications, events, campaigns, and marketing investment.
  • Develops reporting for leadership regarding the reach, effectiveness, and business impact of client communications and events.
  • Partners with Marketing Strategists to identify relevant market trends and growth opportunities and incorporate those insights into client communications and campaigns.
  • Collaborates with Marketing Strategists, Sales, and Client Services on integrated client campaigns and applies engagement information to strengthen segmentation, messaging, targeting, and content relevance.
  • Manages moderately complex communications projects involving multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a matrixed environment, keeping deliverables on schedule and within established budgets.
  • Builds effective working relationships across Global Communications, Marketing, Claims Operations, Client Services, Sales, Legal, and other business functions.
  • Monitors client communication trends and practices within the insurance and third-party administration marketplace to support a current and competitive approach.
  • Provides consultation and informed recommendations to management regarding client communications, content governance, event strategy, and client engagement.

​QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, English, marketing, business, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.


Experience

  • Ten (10) plus years of progressive experience in client, customer, corporate, or marketing communications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
  • Experience within insurance, third-party administration, professional services, or another client-service-intensive industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing moderately to highly complex projects in a matrixed environment required.
  • Experience partnering with and advising executives and senior leaders required.
  • Experience leading client-specific communications, newsletters, webinars, briefings, or events required.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of client, customer, corporate, and marketing communications principles and practices.
  • Strong understanding of voice-of-the-customer principles and the ability to translate complex information into clear, relatable client communications.
  • Strong marketing acumen, including knowledge of audience segmentation, campaign strategy, messaging, targeting, and content marketing principles.
  • Strong analytical and interpretive skills, with demonstrated ability to convert client feedback and engagement information into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute virtual client events, webinars, briefings, newsletters, and other recurring communications.
  • Experience with survey, feedback, engagement analytics, reporting, and content management tools preferred.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including presentation, writing, editing, facilitation, and executive consultation capabilities.
  • Ability to build trust, advise senior leaders, influence stakeholders, and work effectively across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
  • Sound judgment and discretion regarding content governance, accuracy, approvals, confidentiality, risk, and escalation.
  • PC and AI literate, including Microsoft Office products and relevant content, newsletter, event, marketing, survey, and analytics platforms.
  • Ability to meet or exceed performance competencies.

WORK ENVIRONMENT


When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.


Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

Overview

Remote Registered Nurse (RN) – DH Direct Triage

Part-Time, 20 hours per week

Position Summary

The RN - DH Direct Triage provides high-quality, patient-centered care through telephone triage and clinical assessment. This role is 100% hands-on, responsible for assessing patient symptoms, determining the appropriate level of care, providing education, and ensuring timely communication with providers. The ideal candidate has strong triage, Med-Surg, and Primary Care experience, is proficient with Epic EMR, and thrives in an independent remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform telephone triage using established protocols and sound nursing judgment.
  • Assess symptoms, prioritize patient needs, and determine appropriate care or follow-up.
  • Provide patient education, guidance, and reassurance as appropriate.
  • Accurately document all patient encounters in Epic EMR in real time.
  • Escalate urgent or emergent situations per clinic and organizational policies.
  • Communicate effectively with on-call providers, clinic teams, and patients to ensure continuity of care.
  • Contribute to a culture of safety, quality, and patient satisfaction within the triage team.

Qualifications Required:

  • Active, unrestricted RN license (multi-state compact required).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of clinical experience with a strong background in triage, ER, and/or Primary Care.
  • Proficiency in Epic EMR and remote communication systems.
  • Excellent assessment, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and time management abilities.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred:

  • Associates degree required; BSN preferred
  • Previous experience in remote triage, nurse advice lines, or outpatient/clinic settings.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Evenings with weekends and a holiday rotation
  • 100% remote position — requires reliable internet and a secure HIPAA-compliant workspace, free from distractions.

* Eligible candidates will reside in one of the following compact eligible states: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington.

These are just a few highlights of being a nurse at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center and Clinics in New Hampshire.

  • We have loan repayment up to $20,000.
  • We offer Relocation Assistance and a Housing Coordinator to take on the burden of finding a home.
  • We offer generous tuition reimbursement.
  • We have a very popular "earned time" plan.
  • We have extensive CEU/Training programs.
  • Our 8,000 ft Patient Safety and Training Simulation Center is state-of-the-art.
  • Our nurses serve as central figures in the success of our system through our shared governance nursing model.
  • We offer a rigorous, research-focused environment.
  • Dartmouth Hitchcock's Nursing Continuing Education Council is accredited as a provider of continuing nursing. education by the American Nurses Credentialing Center.

Read more about Dartmouth Health and why YOU should work here.

The Dartmouth Health system stretches over New Hampshire and Vermont and offers the quintessential New England experience. With no income or sales tax, this beautiful area combines history, industry, and business and has been ranked consistently as one of the best places in the US to live and work. Anchored by the academic Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center in Lebanon, NH, the system includes the NCI-designated Dartmouth Cancer Center, Dartmouth Health Children’s; member hospitals, and 30 Dartmouth Hitchcock ambulatory clinics across the region. With destinations like Boston, New York, the seacoast, and ski country within driving distance, the opportunities - both career and personal - truly make New Hampshire the ideal place to work and play.

Applicants are encouraged to visit our nursing career site to learn more and apply:

Please visit:

Dartmouth Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Responsibilities

The Clinical Nurse is an engaged and credentialed member of the Professional Nursing Organization and is responsible for autonomous practice directed by the professional tenets of practitioner, leader/decision maker, scientist and transferor. The Clinical Nurse is responsible for utilizing the nursing process to provide evidence-based care and to continuously monitor and evaluate practice to ensure safe passage of patients that is in the best interest of populations served.

Practitioner

  • Utilizes the nursing process to assess, diagnose, identify outcomes, plan, implement and evaluate an individualized plan of care.
  • Utilizes critical thinking and the nursing process to anticipate and recognize changes in patient status, taking action to modify the plan of care or to elevate to the care team as necessary.
  • Practices in accordance with the ANA Code of Ethics to advocate for patients, uphold their autonomy in decision-making, ensure informed consent and assist patients in families in expressing self-determination.
  • Actively seeks feedback and acts to improve performance.
  • Engages in the governance of practice.

    • Leader/Decision Maker

  • Manages interpersonal relationships for self and with others.
  • Mentors colleagues for the advancement of nursing practice and the profession.
  • Assumes authority and accountability for the nursing care of patients while appropriately delegating elements of care to others members of the care delivery team in accordance with laws, regulations and policies and procedures.
  • Prioritizes and organizes time to optimize patient outcomes.

    • Scientist

  • Actively seeks out the most current evidence and standards and applies and translates to daily practice.
  • Role models a culture of inquiry, developing new knowledge by contributing to research, quality improvement, and evidence-based practice at the local level.

    • Transferor

  • Communicates effectively in a variety of formats in all areas of practice.
  • Actively partners with others to effect change that produces positive outcomes through the exchange of knowledge.
  • Precepts the student nurse, nurse extern, nurse resident, experienced clinical nurse and other members of the healthcare team.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned.

    • Qualifications

    • Graduate from an accredited Nursing Program required.
    • Bachelor of Science Degree in Nursing (BSN) preferred.

    Required Licensure/Certifications

    • Licensed Registered Nurse with NH eligibility
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certificate required upon hire.

About the Role

We are a fast-growing beverage brand looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Operations Associate to support the day-to-day execution of our operations function.

The primary focus of this role will be managing order entry, order processing, invoicing, logistics coordination, purchasing follow-up, and operational administration across customers, suppliers, 3PLs, and logistics partners. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, following established SOPs, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining a very high level of accuracy across repetitive but business-critical tasks.

Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20–30 hours per week)

Time Zone: Pacific Time overlap preferred

Compensation: 10 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities

1. Order Management & Fulfillment

Enter customer orders received by email into Cin7 accurately and on time

Review incoming SPS Commerce orders and resolve errors or exceptions

Accept and process orders within Cin7 and ensure all customer information is correct

Verify shipping addresses, pricing, taxes, freight charges, and customer-specific requirements

Monitor orders from entry through shipment and delivery

Update orders as shipment confirmations are received

Coordinate customer pickups and outbound shipments where required

Work closely with 3PLs and logistics partners to ensure orders move on time

2. Invoicing & Transaction Management

Process and manage customer invoicing once orders have shipped

Ensure invoices reflect the correct quantities, pricing, freight, taxes, and customer terms

Review supplier invoices against purchase orders and received quantities

Identify and resolve invoice discrepancies

Track missing invoices and proactively follow up with suppliers

Help keep vendor accounts current and ensure documentation is complete

3. Purchasing & Supplier Coordination

Support the execution and follow-up of purchase orders for packaging, ingredients, and other raw materials

Track open POs and expected delivery dates

Follow up with suppliers to confirm production status, pickup readiness, and on-time delivery

Coordinate inbound freight where required

Confirm receipt of raw materials and transact receipts correctly in Cin7

Flag potential delays or issues before they impact production

4. Logistics & 3PL Coordination

Work closely with logistics brokers, 3PLs, and warehouse partners

Coordinate freight for outbound customer orders and inbound materials

Navigate warehouse management systems and 3PL portals as required

Monitor shipments and resolve delivery or receiving issues

Maintain accurate records of freight movements and shipment status

5. Reporting & Operational Support

Run and distribute reports from Cin7 as required

Support ad hoc data analysis and operational reporting

Investigate system or process errors and troubleshoot where possible

Maintain and improve customer-specific SOPs covering freight, taxes, shipping rules, invoicing, and other requirements

Support general operations projects as priorities evolve

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years in CPG operations, order management, logistics, supply chain, or a similar role

Cin7: Direct hands-on experience with Cin7 is strongly preferred

SPS Commerce: Experience with SPS Commerce is strongly preferred

Systems: Familiarity with warehouse management systems and 3PL operations; strong Google Workspace skills, especially Google Sheets and Excel

Order Management: Experience processing customer orders, invoices, purchase orders, and inventory transactions; strong understanding of order flow from PO through shipment and invoicing

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable coordinating with suppliers, customers, warehouses, and logistics providers

Profile: Extremely strong attention to detail; highly consistent and reliable when completing recurring operational tasks; able to troubleshoot issues rather than simply flagging them; proactive about following up on missing information, invoices, shipments, or open items; comfortable working independently within established SOPs

About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

The Director, Sales - New Logo (Acquisition) is responsible for leading new customer acquisition and revenue growth across the Nexcess Managed Cloud business in North America. This role leads a team of approximately 5–8 Account Executives and owns team performance against monthly, quarterly, and annual recurring revenue and new business targets.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying sales leadership role. The Director will recruit, onboard, coach, and develop Account Executives while remaining actively involved in customer conversations, opportunity strategy, commercial negotiations, and closing key deals.

The role will drive a disciplined, prospecting-led sales motion focused on mid-market organizations with revenue-critical and compliance-sensitive technology environments. Solutions include managed cloud, managed dedicated servers, private cloud, managed Windows and Linux workloads, compliance-ready infrastructure, and managed security services.

The Director will partner closely with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and Technical Account Management to build pipeline, improve territory penetration, win competitive displacement opportunities, and convert new customers into durable recurring revenue relationships.

The compensation range for this position is between $175k-$225k base + commission.

Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & New Logo Acquisition

  • Own new logo sales performance across North America, including MRC bookings, recurring revenue targets, pipeline generation, quota attainment, and territory coverage.
  • Develop and execute sales plans designed to achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual new business targets.
  • Establish appropriate pipeline coverage expectations based on quota, conversion rates, sales cycles, and territory opportunity.
  • Drive consistent prospecting and new account development across the Account Executive team.
  • Identify and develop competitive displacement opportunities within target markets.
  • Expand opportunities across the Managed Cloud portfolio, including private cloud, compliance, security, and managed services.
  • Balance revenue growth with contract quality, recurring revenue value, term, margin, and long-term customer potential.

Sales Execution & Deal Leadership

  • Maintain an active role in strategic and complex opportunities by participating in customer meetings, opportunity strategy, solution development, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
  • Coach Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, from initial qualification and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to align technical solutions with customer business, infrastructure, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Apply and reinforce MEDDPICC/MEDDICC or a comparable structured sales methodology across qualification, opportunity reviews, deal inspection, and stage progression.
  • Establish consistent expectations for opportunity quality, next steps, stakeholder engagement, decision criteria, and close planning.
  • Support Account Executives in navigating technical and executive-level customer conversations.
  • Develop repeatable sales plays for target segments and competitive scenarios.

Sales Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 5–8 Account Executives responsible for new logo acquisition.
  • Establish clear individual expectations for quota attainment, pipeline creation, activity, territory coverage, forecasting, and sales execution.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, deal reviews, coaching sessions, and performance discussions.
  • Identify performance gaps early and establish clear coaching, development, and performance improvement expectations.
  • Recognize high performance and develop Account Executives with the capability and interest to take on expanded responsibilities or future leadership opportunities.
  • Build a collaborative, accountable sales culture focused on execution, continuous improvement, and customer outcomes.

Recruiting, Onboarding & Development

  • Maintain an active pipeline of qualified Account Executive candidates to support approved growth and anticipated backfill needs.
  • Partner with PX and leadership to identify hiring needs, territory coverage gaps, and potential performance-related staffing risks.
  • Lead the onboarding and early development of newly hired Account Executives.
  • Establish target accounts and territory penetration plans with new Account Executives within their first 90 days.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Sales Operations to establish individualized development plans covering product knowledge, methodology, competitive positioning, pipeline development, and forecasting.
  • Coach through call reviews, customer meetings, opportunity inspection, deal strategy, and regular performance discussions.
  • Ensure new Account Executives demonstrate proficiency in core selling competencies within approximately 45 days and progress toward full productivity within approximately 90 days.

Territory, Pipeline & Forecast Management

  • Manage the North American territory model to ensure appropriate alignment between market opportunity, Account Executive capacity, pipeline expectations, and quota.
  • Monitor territory penetration and identify areas requiring increased prospecting, campaign support, account development, or resource allocation.
  • Maintain visibility into pipeline health, coverage, velocity, conversion, deal risk, and expected bookings.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate weekly forecasts to the VP of Sales, including commit, best-case, pipeline risk, and expected bookings.
  • Establish a consistent forecast cadence and hold Account Executives accountable for forecast quality and accuracy.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities, activity, stage progression, next steps, close dates, and forecasting information are complete and current.
  • Use sales data and performance trends to identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring leadership intervention.

Go-to-Market & Market Development

  • Develop sales strategies for priority customer segments, including complex commerce, healthcare and compliance-driven organizations, SaaS businesses, professional services organizations, and businesses operating mission-critical applications.
  • Partner with Marketing on campaigns, account-based programs, lead generation, competitive positioning, and coordinated go-to-market initiatives.
  • Translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable recommendations for sales strategy, messaging, product positioning, and pricing.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities and recommend adjustments to territories, sales plays, targeting, or resource allocation.
  • Represent Nexcess Managed Cloud in strategic customer meetings, industry events, and partner conversations.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Customer Lifecycle

  • Partner closely with Sales Engineering throughout technical discovery, solution design, and opportunity development.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales Operations to improve pipeline generation, sales execution, reporting, and overall go-to-market effectiveness.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Technical Account Management teams to ensure clean handoffs from new business acquisition into the post-sale customer lifecycle.
  • Establish clear expectations for transferring customer objectives, technical requirements, commitments, risks, and expansion opportunities to post-sale teams.
  • Support land-and-expand strategies that position new customers for broader adoption of Nexcess services over time.
  • Provide leadership with recurring feedback regarding customer needs, competitive activity, pricing considerations, and barriers to growth.

Additional Expectations

  • Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision-making.
    • Design
    • Ownership
    • First Team
    • Performance
  • Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives.
  • Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience selling technology solutions or services in a recurring-revenue environment.
  • 3+ years of sales leadership, sales management, or equivalent experience leading and developing quota-carrying sales professionals.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, or a related field.
    • Equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated success building new logo pipeline and acquiring new customers through prospecting-led sales motions.
  • Experience leading sales teams responsible for monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue or bookings targets.
  • Experience actively selling alongside direct reports and supporting opportunity development, negotiation, and deal closure.
  • Demonstrated experience using a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or MEDDICC for qualification, deal inspection, and coaching.
  • Experience managing sales forecasts, pipeline coverage, opportunity stages, and team-level commit processes.
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Strong understanding of recurring revenue models, including MRC and ARR, term-based agreements, discounting, and margin considerations.
  • Experience coaching, setting performance expectations, evaluating results, and addressing performance gaps within a sales team.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and executive decision-makers.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Sales Operations, Customer Success, or similar teams.

Preferred

  • Experience selling managed hosting, managed cloud, dedicated servers, IaaS, MSP services, private cloud, or similar infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience selling managed Windows, Linux, database, virtualization, or hyperconverged infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience selling compliance-driven infrastructure supporting PCI, HIPAA, SOC, or similar requirements.
  • Experience selling managed security solutions, including firewall, backup and disaster recovery, endpoint protection, EDR, or MDR services.
  • Experience developing and executing competitive displacement or incumbent takeout strategies.
  • Experience leading high-velocity mid-market sales teams managing multiple active opportunities and closes per representative.
  • Experience selling to IT Directors, infrastructure leaders, technical founders, business owners, CFOs, and other technical or executive decision-makers.
  • Experience building or expanding sales teams, territories, or go-to-market motions within a growing or evolving technology organization.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual new logo MRC bookings attainment.
  • Individual and team quota attainment.
  • New logo revenue growth.
  • Pipeline creation and pipeline coverage against quota.
  • Forecast accuracy and consistency of weekly commit.
  • Account Executive ramp time and time to first productive selling activity.
  • Territory penetration and new account acquisition.
  • Competitive displacement wins.
  • Average deal value, recurring revenue, contract term, and margin quality.
  • Attach and expansion opportunities involving private cloud, compliance, security, and managed services.
  • Sales team retention, development, and performance progression.
  • Salesforce data quality and sales process adherence.

Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear
  • While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to use hands for keyboarding, gross manipulation, and fine manipulation
  • Works at a desk and computer screen for extended periods of time

Lubricants Billing Specialist

Position Summary

The Lubricant Billing Specialist is responsible for accurate and timely invoicing, pricing validation, and account reconciliation within a wholesale finished lubricants distribution environment. This role ensures billing integrity across bulk lubricants, packaged lubricants, and related services while supporting customer satisfaction, margin protection, and compliance with contractual pricing agreements.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Invoicing

  • Generate and process high-volume invoices for bulk lubricants, packaged goods, DEF, and related services.
  • Ensure accurate application of pricing structures, including contract pricing, spot pricing, and index-based adjustments.
  • Validate freight, fuel surcharges, and additive/service charges prior to invoice release.
  • Manage automated and manual billing processes within ERP systems.

Pricing & Contract Compliance

  • Maintain and update customer pricing matrices based on supplier cost changes, index movements (e.g., base oil postings), and negotiated agreements.
  • Review and audit invoices to ensure margin accuracy and alignment with company pricing policies.
  • Coordinate with sales and procurement teams on pricing discrepancies or updates.

Account Reconciliation & Dispute Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, short-pays, and customer disputes in a timely manner.
  • Reconcile customer accounts and support Accounts Receivable with aging issues tied to billing errors.
  • Issue credits, rebills, and adjustments as needed with proper documentation.

Operational Coordination

  • Work closely with dispatch, logistics, and warehouse teams to ensure delivery tickets (BOLs) align with billed quantities and products.
  • Verify tax application (sales tax, environmental fees, etc.) based on jurisdiction and product type.
  • Support month-end close processes, including accruals and billing cutoffs.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Generate billing accuracy and exception reports.
  • Identify trends in billing errors or margin leakage and recommend process improvements.
  • Assist with system enhancements, automation initiatives, and data integrity efforts.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 2+ years of billing, invoicing, or accounting experience, preferably in fuel, lubricants, or industrial distribution.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or industry-specific platforms).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis).
  • Familiarity with pricing structures tied to commodity markets is a plus.

Industry Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Understanding of finished lubricants, base oils, and related product categories.
  • Exposure to wholesale distribution operations, including bulk and packaged deliveries.

Core Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving
  • Ability to manage high-volume transactions under tight deadlines
  • Effective communication across sales, operations, and finance teams
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong follow-through

Working Conditions

  • Remote based role with periodic interaction with warehouse and operations teams when in the office.
  • May require extended hours during month-end close or price change cycles.

Overview

Acuity Inc. is growing. We are seeking a Lead ServiceNow Developer (ITSM SME) to support a highly visible federal ServiceNow platform modernization initiative.

This role leads the technical implementation of ITSM capabilities across the ServiceNow platform, supporting both platform assessment and enterprise modernization efforts. The developer collaborates closely with the Platform Architect, government stakeholders, and engineering teams to implement configuration-first ServiceNow capabilities aligned with modern ITSM practices and ServiceNow architectural standards.

The position requires deep expertise in ITSM process implementation, ServiceNow configuration, and workflow development to deliver scalable, maintainable service management capabilities across the enterprise platform.

Why Acuity?

If you are passionate about using your skills in IT Modernization, Data Enablement, and Hyperautomation to make a positive impact, you might find a good fit at Acuity. We serve federal agencies as a trusted digital strategy and technology consulting firm, providing innovative technical leadership to support our customers’ critical missions.

Responsibilities

The Lead Developer (ITSM SME) works with a multidisciplinary ServiceNow team to implement and modernize enterprise ITSM capabilities. The individual will:

  • Lead technical implementation of ServiceNow ITSM capabilities including Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident, and Knowledge Management.
  • Configure and implement ITSM capabilities using configuration-first ServiceNow development patterns aligned with platform best practices.
  • Support platform assessment activities by analyzing existing workflows, configurations, scripts, and customization patterns that impact platform maintainability and upgrade readiness.
  • Translate ITSM process requirements into scalable ServiceNow configurations, workflows, and service catalog capabilities.

  • Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and external enterprise systems.
  • Create Automated Test Framework (ATF) tests to support platform quality, regression testing, and upgrade readiness.
  • Work within an Agile delivery model, supporting backlog refinement, story estimation, sprint delivery, and technical implementation of user stories.
  • Collaborate with architects, functional leads, and government stakeholders to implement scalable platform capabilities.
  • Implement solutions aligned with platform governance standards, configuration-first architecture, and long-term maintainability.
  • Maintain technical documentation including configuration standards, implementation documentation, and platform development guidance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university, preferably in a related technical field.
  • Minimum five (5) years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience supporting enterprise ITSM implementations.
  • Extensive knowledge of ITIL and ITSM processes.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing ServiceNow ITSM capabilities including Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management.
  • Experience configuring and administering ServiceNow platform capabilities.
  • Experience developing workflows, business rules, and integrations within the ServiceNow platform.

EPE is in search of a Power Systems Engineer with a background in EMT modelling and power system studies to join our growing Energy Resources team.   • Support client presentations, pursuit efforts, and preconstruction meetings while serving as a trusted advisor throughout the planning process.

raw.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Human Interest is seeking a high-performing Retirement Sales Activation Manager to lead a dynamic team responsible for driving efficiency, velocity, and customer satisfaction throughout the conversion process. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and has a passion for optimizing processes, managing performance, and exceeding aggressive targets.

You will be accountable for hitting key performance metrics, identifying and solving operational blockers, and leading your team to consistently launch a high volume of plans while delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you are energized by metrics, people development, and fast-changing environments, this is the opportunity for you. We move at 24,791 mph - you should be ready to lead at speed.

What you get to do every day

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a team of sales activation specialists to exceed individual and team-based monthly quotas.
  • Develop and execute strategies to drive a high volume of successful plan launches each month, in alignment with departmental KPIs and business goals.
  • Own team performance by closely inspecting conversion pipelines, managing pre-launch churn, and ensuring adherence to process and talk tracks.
  • Actively monitor and optimize conversion workflows to increase velocity, remove bottlenecks, and drive operational excellence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Program Management, Customer Success, and senior leadership to resolve customer escalations and continuously improve the conversion experience.
  • Identify performance gaps within your team and implement coaching, enablement, and process improvements to drive results.
  • Forecast conversion targets and contribute to capacity planning by analyzing trends and pipeline health.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement while fostering a fun, energetic, and collaborative team environment.

What success looks like

  • Achieve and exceed monthly conversion quota targets for your team.
  • Ensure a healthy mix of plan types (e.g., Safe Harbor and Auto-Enroll) to meet internal performance benchmarks.
  • Consistently minimize pre-launch churn by proactively identifying and resolving customer pain points.
  • Improve conversion cycle times and conversion rates through process optimization and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Establish your team as a key driver of customer activation and revenue acceleration within Human Interest.
  • Champion a culture of excellence and psychological safety, empowering the team to hit ambitious targets while feeling supported.

What you bring to the role

  • 3-5 years of total professional experience, with at least 2+ years in a people leadership role within Sales, Implementation, or a related function in a SaaS or Retirement/Financial Services environment.
  • Proven track record of success in a quota-carrying and target-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of 401(k) plan design or the ability to quickly develop subject-matter expertise.
  • Highly data-driven mindset with expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and performance coaching.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to drive action in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize processes, improve operational efficiency, and execute against aggressive targets.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a knack for motivating teams, resolving conflict, and collaborating across departments.
  • Experience managing high-volume customer portfolios and overseeing complex projects or implementations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, we consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate pay range for each position, including the cost of labor in different markets across the U.S. The total On Target Earnings (OTE) for the role described in this job posting is $140,000 - $150,000 which includes a base salary of $100,000-$105,000 and a variable target compensation of $40,000 to $45,000. The specific pay rate offered is based on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. Hourly pay is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. Additionally, employees receive stock option grants, enhancing long-term financial growth and investment in our company's success.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - Fundraising / Non Profits
raw.excerpt: About Nexcess Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist.
raw.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

The Senior Product Manager – Digital Software will lead product strategy and development for the company's fundraising and donation products, serving nonprofits, charities, faith organizations, schools, and other mission-driven organizations.

This role is responsible for product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, product performance, and client experience within the assigned portfolio. The position requires a strong understanding of digital fundraising, online payments, donor experiences, and the operational needs of organizations that rely on fundraising technology.

The Senior Product Manager will use client insights, market information, product data, and business objectives to inform product decisions and recommendations. Company-level AI strategy and broader software portfolio strategy remain under the direction of the VP of Product, with the Senior Product Manager contributing relevant client, market, and domain expertise.

The role works closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Client Success, Support, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Security, payment providers, technology partners, and other stakeholders. The Senior Product Manager is expected to lead cross-functional initiatives through influence and make product decisions within established priorities, delegated authority, company policies, and applicable governance processes.

Compensation: The compensation range for this position is between $125k-$170k in the US and £95k-£150k in the UK depending on location and experience.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Management

  • Develop and maintain product strategy for assigned fundraising and donation products based on client needs, market conditions, product performance, business objectives, and available resources.
  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps that establish priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, investments, and expected outcomes.
  • Define and prioritize product features, capabilities, packaging, service offerings, and client experiences within established business and approval processes.
  • Evaluate competitive and market developments and incorporate relevant insights into product recommendations.
  • Manage product lifecycle activities, including enhancements, supported versions, deprecations, client transitions, and data migration considerations.
  • Identify and communicate product risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and potential client or business impacts.

Fundraising and Donor Experience

  • Develop and maintain working knowledge of the digital fundraising lifecycle, including donation forms, one-time and recurring giving, donor accounts, acknowledgements, and donor engagement.
  • Guide product requirements for fundraising capabilities such as campaigns, appeals, peer-to-peer fundraising, events, pledges, tribute giving, matching gifts, and designated funds.
  • Improve the recurring giving experience, including subscription management, donor self-service, payment recovery, and retention.
  • Partner with appropriate internal subject-matter experts to identify product requirements related to charitable receipting, tax documentation, privacy, consent, data retention, accessibility, and other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure product requirements appropriately address donor data, reporting, exports, and authorized access in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Define reporting and analytics requirements that support client decision-making and organizational needs.

Payments, Trust, and Security

  • Define and prioritize product requirements for payment methods, payment providers, recurring payments, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and related client experiences.
  • Partner with Engineering, Security, payment providers, and other appropriate stakeholders to support payment reliability, fraud prevention, data protection, and security requirements.
  • Consider applicable payment, privacy, accessibility, and security requirements when developing product plans and recommendations.
  • Escalate legal, regulatory, security, privacy, compliance, or other specialized matters to the appropriate internal subject-matter experts.
  • Support product planning for periods of increased fundraising activity and client demand.

Commercial Product Performance

  • Develop product priorities that support approved client and business objectives, which may include adoption, conversion, retention, expansion, revenue, margin, and other relevant measures.
  • Develop business cases and investment recommendations that consider client value, market opportunity, anticipated business impact, costs, resources, risks, and strategic alignment.
  • Provide product input into pricing, packaging, monetization, and go-to-market decisions within established approval processes.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Client Success, and other teams on product positioning, launches, adoption, and client growth.

Product Development and Innovation

  • Identify client needs, market opportunities, and potential product enhancements or new capabilities.
  • Lead client discovery, validation, prototyping, and experimentation activities with relevant client and user groups.
  • Define and prioritize initial product scope and establish measurable success criteria.
  • Balance client value, product quality, technical feasibility, resources, risks, timing, and business objectives throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate product launches and evaluate results following release.

AI and Portfolio Strategy

  • Contribute client, market, and product expertise to the company's broader AI and software strategy under the direction of the VP of Product.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to fundraising experiences and workflows while considering client value, data considerations, product quality, security, and applicable company requirements.
  • Translate approved company and portfolio strategies into actionable product plans and priorities.
  • Communicate relevant product, client, and market insights to support broader portfolio planning.

Product Performance and Measurement

  • Establish and monitor product KPIs aligned with approved product and business objectives.
  • Partner with relevant teams to support appropriate product instrumentation, data quality, reporting, and performance measurement.
  • Monitor metrics such as donation conversion, recurring donor retention, payment success, product adoption, client engagement, and other relevant measures.
  • Communicate product performance, key insights, risks, and recommendations to product leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative information to evaluate product performance and inform prioritization and investment recommendations.

Client and Market Engagement

  • Engage with nonprofit organizations, fundraising professionals, agencies, consultants, donors, and client-facing teams to understand client needs and product opportunities.
  • Incorporate client feedback and experience considerations into product strategy and prioritization.
  • Monitor relevant developments in fundraising technology, nonprofit technology, payments, WordPress, and related industries.
  • Maintain productive relationships with technology, integration, payment, and other relevant external partners.
  • Represent the company and its products professionally and in accordance with applicable company policies and communications guidelines.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional product initiatives by establishing clear objectives, priorities, responsibilities, decision-making processes, and measures of success.
  • Facilitate alignment across stakeholders and support timely resolution of product risks, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Communicate product strategy, priorities, decisions, and changes clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Build effective working relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, client Success, Support, Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance, and other functions.
  • Share product knowledge and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of product management practices.
  • Provide leadership and direction within the scope of assigned responsibilities and delegated authority.
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned based on organizational and business needs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product Strategy: Establish and execute a clear product strategy and roadmap aligned with client and business objectives.
  • Client Value: Improve the experience and outcomes for organizations and donors through effective product prioritization and development.
  • Business Performance: Contribute to agreed product and business outcomes through effective planning, execution, and optimization.
  • Trust and Reliability: Support products that meet applicable company, security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements in partnership with the appropriate subject-matter experts.
  • Data-Informed Decisions: Use meaningful product metrics, client feedback, and market insights to inform decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Build alignment and effectively lead initiatives across functions.
  • Execution: Translate strategy into clear priorities while appropriately managing dependencies, risks, resources, and changing business conditions.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant professional experience in product management, including experience operating at a Senior, Lead, or comparable level of responsibility, scope, and decision-making.
  • Experience with fundraising, donation, payments, ecommerce, subscription, or other transactional digital products.
  • Working knowledge of online payments, including payment gateways, recurring billing, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and payment recovery.
  • Understanding of the needs and operating environment of nonprofits or other mission-driven organizations.
  • Familiarity with product considerations related to privacy, data protection, accessibility, security, and payment processing.
  • Experience contributing to commercial product outcomes such as revenue, adoption, retention, pricing, packaging, monetization, or margin.
  • Experience defining, monitoring, and interpreting product and business KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and launching products, features, or product capabilities from concept through client availability and ongoing improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather and incorporate client feedback into product strategy and prioritization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, including APIs, integrations, data flows, and system dependencies, and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and building alignment among technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate product strategy, priorities, recommendations, and decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with WordPress and related fundraising products, including GiveWP or comparable platforms.
  • Experience working with nonprofits, charities, faith organizations, educational institutions, or other mission-driven organizations.
  • Experience with peer-to-peer fundraising, events, campaigns, recurring giving, or donor engagement.
  • Experience integrating fundraising products with CRM, donor management, accounting, marketing, or other business systems.
  • Experience with international fundraising, multi-currency payments, or regional payment methods.
  • Experience with fraud prevention and risk management for public-facing payment experiences.
  • Experience developing or managing AI-enabled product capabilities.
  • Experience working within a multi-product or software portfolio organization.
  • Familiarity with open-source software communities, contribution models, governance practices, or commercial models.
  • Experience working with distributed or cross-functional teams in a technology or software environment.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described below are representative of those that may be encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

  • This position routinely requires the ability to communicate effectively and exchange information with others.
  • The position requires regular use of a computer, keyboard, and other standard office equipment.
  • The individual may be required to remain in a stationary position and work at a desk or computer for extended periods.
  • The position may be performed in a climate-controlled office environment or an approved remote work environment.
  • The role involves managing multiple priorities, responding to evolving business needs, and meeting time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Occasional movement of office materials or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds may be required.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and its primary responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations. It is not intended to be an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Responsibilities may be modified, expanded, or reassigned as business needs and organizational priorities evolve.

Nothing in this job description creates or implies an employment contract or guarantee of employment for any specific period. Where applicable, employment remains at-will, meaning either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice or cause, subject to applicable law.

The Company reserves the right to update this job description as appropriate to reflect changes in the position, business needs, or applicable requirements.

raw.description:
About Us:-

Prometheum is building the market infrastructure that brings securities onto the blockchain. Our SEC-registered broker-dealer network carries a digital asset through its entire life, from issuance and distribution to qualified custody, correspondent clearing, and secondary market trading, all within U.S. securities law.

That work has put us first more than once. We became the first SEC-registered special purpose broker-dealer, and the first to trade ETH inside a traditional brokerage account. Those milestones rest on systems our engineers build every day, and we are searching for engineers like you to help us grow our team.

Role:-

Blockchain Engineer 2 - Full time W2

Salary Range:-

$130,000 - $165,000

Overview:-

As a Blockchain Engineer 2, you take ownership of a whole feature once an epic is agreed on. Epics come from the Architect and CTO, but they are shaped in team brainstorms where you are expected to bring a view, including what is happening across the blockchain and cryptography landscape and how it should change our approach. Once we have consensus, you break the work into pieces the team can pick up, get it ready to build, guide it through to release, and keep stakeholders honestly informed along the way. You will work with the Architect on technical design, with guidance from senior engineers as you grow into that part of the job.

We are a specialist team. Other teams depend on us for custody contracts, transaction signing and orchestration, and the key management that ties them together, work they cannot do themselves, so our output is measured by how well it serves those teams and the customers behind them, not by how much of it you shipped. When something is not moving, we expect you to say so early and come with options.

Our engineering team is fully remote.

Responsibilities:-

  • Build and maintain secure and optimized blockchain applications
  • Own epics end to end, from story writing and pointing through delivery and release
  • Build across many different languages taking on the large, complex problems in your team's scope
  • Report progress on your epic regularly and accurately, and raise risks before they become surprises
  • Partner with senior engineers on technical design, architecture decisions, and future epics
  • Demonstrate a passion for learning, building, and constantly improving cutting-edge applications
  • Communicate often to encourage tight and quick feedback loops and remove potential blockers
  • Use AI coding tools as a default part of your workflow, and review what they produce with the same rigor you would apply to your own code
  • Review teammates' code in a way that catches design concerns, edge cases, and test gaps
  • Work directly with neighboring systems throughout delivery, not just at the handoff
  • Investigate and resolve issues found in QA, UAT, and production

Qualifications:-

  • 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software
  • Strong blockchain fundamental knowledge including in-depth knowledge of top chains (i.e. Bitcoin and Ethereum)
  • Familiarity with basic cryptography commonly utilized by blockchains

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

About the team

The Senior Solution Consultant as a fully proficient professional will be responsible for understanding Kinaxis customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and will be committed to helping our customers solve complex issues in their supply chain management practice. The incumbent will work with new and existing customers and will provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experience the immediate value of Kinaxis solutions.

The incumbent will act as a functional lead on projects by providing consulting services and leadership during deployment of Maestro supply chain software and leverage advanced knowledge of the product and supply chain industry trends and best practices to achieve desired outcomes.

  • Guide and mentor more junior consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • 2 to 3 years’ experience in a functional leadership capacity for system configuration or system deployments.
  • 2 to 3 years’ experience in business process design for supply chain software implementations.
  • Passion for working in customer-facing roles and able to demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complex information to determine best course of action.
  • Self-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast-paced work environment.

  • Ability to work in a collaborative matrixed environment with multiple team members.

  • Experience working with supply chain processes and manufacturing planning solutions such as Maestro, SAP, Oracle or Blue Yonder applications to support supply chain activities.
  • Proficiency in SQL, R and/or Java Script.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

American College of Education (ACE) is seeking a strategic, data-driven marketing professional who excels at creating and optimizing multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that engage prospective students and drive conversion. You leverage insights from campaign performance, application, enrollment, and start metrics to make informed decisions that improve outcomes. You are passionate about delivering consistent, brand-aligned communications across platforms, while continuously testing and refining personalized messaging, offers, and communication strategies to enhance engagement, retention, and program participation. You thrive in a collaborative environment, balancing analytical thinking with creativity to create exceptional student experiences.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The following contract role starts at $75.00 per hour. This position is a month-to-month contract.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Develops, executes, and optimizes multi-channel lifecycle marketing campaigns (including email and SMS) to nurture prospective students, drive action, and ensure conversion rates are stable.
  • Evaluates and reports on key metrics for campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitors lifecycle KPIs for applications, enrollments, and starts.
  • Leads optimizations to improve lifecycle communications using data-informed decisions.
  • Ensures consistency in lifecycle communications across all communication platforms and partner to ensure brand standards are adhered to.
  • Develops testing strategies for personalized communication, including targeted offers and messages, to enhance student retention and program participation.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Expertise in CRM and marketing automation platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics and Click Dimensions.

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT, Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will need to be reported to a direct leader.

Internet bandwidth speeds from an employee's remote work location must be a minimum of 50Mbps download speeds and 5Mbps upload speeds. Please note if the bandwidth is shared across multiple devices (tablets, computer, streaming, phone, etc.) you will need higher overall speeds. You can test the speed of your connection by visiting speedtest.net. Purchase, setup, installation, support, and ongoing maintenance of reliable internet service is the responsibility of the individual.

American College of Education seeks to attract and retain a diverse staff consistent with its diverse student body and surrounding communities. At this time we cannot consider candidates residing in Alaska, Washington D.C., Massachusetts, South Dakota, or Alabama.

ACE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
