raw.title: Legal Counsel, Emergency Cash & U.S. Programs
raw.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
raw.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly is building a faster model for humanitarian response – using data, technology, and partnerships to identify people affected by crises and deliver cash within days. Making that possible requires legal pathways that can be established before a crisis and activated quickly when one occurs.

We are seeking a Counsel to build and lead that legal model. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Emergency Cash, from preparing for future responses to leading the legal and regulatory work required during an active emergency. When a response is underway, EC work will take priority.

You will also serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs, which work with governments, funders, researchers, and community organizations to deliver cash to low-income Americans. The portfolio includes programs such as Rx Kids, guaranteed-income initiatives, and housing-stability programs. You will help teams design and expand these programs, structure partnerships, and navigate the legal issues affecting delivery and recipients.

This is a delivery-focused role for a practical lawyer who can build for scale, exercise clear judgment under pressure, and help ambitious programs move from idea to implementation.

Reports to: Head of Legal

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirement: ~ 3–4 trips per year, plus travel as needed during active emergency responses.

What you’ll do:

Build and deliver the Emergency Cash legal model

  • Serve as the primary legal partner to Emergency Cash across program strategy, design, launch, and delivery.
  • Build a repeatable legal model for emergency responses, including approaches to country entry, regulatory review, government engagement, contracting, data use, and the engagement of local counsel.
  • Develop response-readiness tools, templates, and decision frameworks that allow common issues to be addressed quickly while escalating matters requiring legal judgment.
  • During active responses, lead the legal work needed to launch and operate on emergency timelines, providing clear recommendations when information is incomplete.
  • Coordinate with country teams, program-facing Counsel, and local advisors to use existing knowledge and relationships while retaining legal ownership of the response.
  • Apply GiveDirectly’s global standards for MNO data and remote enablement to individual responses, working with the Corporate & Strategic Affairs Counsel on novel or cross-cutting issues.
  • Draft and negotiate the partnership, technology, vendor, data-sharing, and other agreements required to deliver emergency programs.
  • Capture lessons from individual responses and use them to strengthen the EC legal model over time.

Lead legal support for U.S. programs

  • Serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs across program design, implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations.
  • Advise on the legal design and delivery of U.S. cash programs, including eligible recipient populations, interactions with public benefits, tax treatment and reporting, payments involving minors or caregivers, family-law considerations, privacy and data use, and state-specific requirements.
  • Structure and negotiate program-specific agreements with governments, research institutions, community organizations, payment providers, and other partners.
  • Develop reusable guidance for recurring issues and coordinate state-specific or specialist counsel where needed.

Contribute across Legal

  • Work with the Corporate & Business Affairs Counsel on organization-wide standards and initiatives affecting Emergency Cash or U.S. programs.
  • Partner with the Africa Programs & Country Operations Counsel when emergency responses occur in countries within that role’s portfolio.
  • Work with Legal Operations support to delegate recurring contracting, research, coordination, and administrative work appropriately.
  • Support other priority legal matters as needed as part of a small, global Legal team.

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • Qualification as an attorney in at least one jurisdiction, with relevant post-qualification legal experience.
  • Experience advising on complex program, commercial, or regulatory matters in fast-moving or high-pressure environments.
  • Strong commercial contracting skills, including drafting and negotiating complex partnership, technology, vendor, or data-related agreements.
  • Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar legal and regulatory frameworks and advise where precedent, time, or information is limited.
  • Strong legal and business judgment, including the ability to identify meaningful risks, assess tradeoffs, and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for colleagues without legal backgrounds.
  • Experience coordinating external counsel, consultants, or other specialist advisors.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy and data protection law.
  • Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and reprioritize quickly during active emergency responses.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; English fluency.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience in emergency response, humanitarian operations, or other crisis-context legal work.
    • Experience supporting the launch of programs or operations in new countries.
    • Experience with U.S. public-benefits, family-law, charitable-assistance, or government-program matters.
    • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, particularly in emerging markets.
    • Experience supporting programs involving vulnerable populations or sensitive personal data.
    • Experience in international development or another mission-driven organization.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $134,400
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$13,440, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $15,724 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $147,840+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £91,900
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~£9,190 with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £10,752 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £101,090+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $106,280
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$10,628, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $12,434 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $116,908+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A supportive team that works hard and cares hard
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take
  • Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible application process for all of our open roles. If there are questions or concerns you have about the accessibility of our hiring process, we warmly invite you to reach out to .

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

raw.title: Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are Skyward. That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology.
raw.description:
We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need a Software Engineer who does it all.

Would your friends say you can dissect a complex problem until it quietly gives up? Have you been told (more than once) that you care suspiciously much about modernizing the crusty old systems powering public services ? Good. We’re not bored, we’re impressed.

Here’s the thing: we don’t want an engineer who only writes code and tosses it over the wall. We want the rare one who writes it, automates the pipeline that ships it, and builds the tests that prove it works, and then sleeps soundly because of it. If you believe “done” means tested, deployed, and monitored (not “it runs on my laptop”), then we want you.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Build things that matter.Write effective, scalable code supporting CMS as it merges systems into one AI-driven platform - reducing manual effort, improving data accuracy, and bringing cutting-edge NLP and LLM techniques to public services.
  • Automate all the toil.Own CI/CD pipelines end to end, automating build, test, and deployment workflows with tools like Jenkins, plus Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) so deployments are boring in the best possible way.
  • Test like you mean it.Build and maintain automated test suites - unit, integration, regression - wired straight into the pipeline as quality gates, and provide real test-coverage analysis instead of crossed fingers.
  • Containerize and ship.Package and deploy workloads with Docker (and friends) for repeatable, scalable, what-you-build-is-what-you-run environments.
  • Hunt the bugs.Investigate and debug test failures throughout the lifecycle, update tests or file bugs as needed, and keep the build green and honest.
  • Bake in security.Integrate code-quality checks and security gates (think SonarQube, Snyk) into the pipeline so problems get caught before they ship, not after.
  • Design with humans in mind.Work closely with human-centered design experts to build solutions that are intuitive, responsive, and personalized to each user’s needs.
  • Make things faster.Develop and tune back-end components to improve responsiveness and overall performance.

What we’d like you to have:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong coding chops in Python (and friends).
  • Real DevOps / DevSecOps / DevTestOps experience. You know CI/CD isn’t a buzzword; you’ve actually automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
  • Test automation skill. You’ve built automated tests and integrated them into pipelines with code-quality checks and security gates, not bolted them on at the end.
  • A feel for good pipelines. Scalable, maintainable, and integrated with testing frameworks. You know, the kind that make the whole team faster.
  • Containerization experience (Docker or Kubernetes) and comfort with REST APIs.
  • Fluency in an agile flavor or two - Scrum, Lean, or SAFe.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across a busy mix of stakeholders.

What would blow us away:

  • You’ve got AI chops, experience with NLP, LLMs, or ML-driven applications.
  • You’ve previously supported CMSor another federal agency.
  • Bonus unicorn pointsif you’ve worked inside a FISMA boundary or supported an ATO/cATO effort.

    • Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
  • Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!
At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.
Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.
Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance due to the nature of our work as a government contractor.

raw.description:
For 30 years, SQA Services has been a premier leader in providing managed supplier quality services for audits, assessments, remote surveillance assessments, corrective actions, remediation, inspections, and engineering to manufacturers within all industries. We deliver services by deploying associates who are located throughout the United States and in 90+ countries around the world to your supplier sites. Our associates are expert quality assurance professionals with broad experience and local knowledge who can represent our clients on-demand and on-site faster than our competitors.
The Travel Coordinator is responsible for coordinating domestic and international business travel while ensuring compliance with company travel policies and budget requirements. This position serves as the primary point of contact for employee travel, manages travel-related expenses and documentation, and provides support to travelers before, during, and after their trips.

Responsibilities

    • Coordinate and book domestic and international business travel, including flights, hotels, rental cars, and ground transportation through the company's travel management platform or other approved booking methods when business needs require.
    • Research and provide travel itineraries, pricing options, and cost comparisons to support business travel planning.
    • Review travel requests and bookings to ensure compliance with company travel policies, preferred vendors, approval requirements, and budget guidelines.
    • Coordinate travel approvals and communicate with managers regarding travel requests and policy requirements.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee travel inquiries and provide timely assistance before, during, and after travel.
    • Provide guidance and training to employees on travel policies, booking procedures, and use of the company's travel management platform.
    • Assist travelers with itinerary changes, cancellations, delays, and other time-sensitive travel disruptions
    • Communicate with the company's travel management platform, airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors to resolve booking issues, refunds, credits, billing discrepancies, and other travel-related concerns.
    • Administer and maintain the company's travel management platform, including user accounts, traveler profiles, system settings, and policy configurations.
    • Track and manage unused airline ticket credits, ensuring available credits are applied toward future business travel whenever possible.
    • Review, reconcile, and process corporate travel expenses, ensuring charges are accurate, properly documented, and compliant with company policies.
    • Monitor corporate travel spending and prepare travel-related reports as needed.
    • Submit and manage timesheets within SQA's internal system, ensuring accurate billing, proper documentation, and timely processing of adjustment timesheets when required.
    • Update travel forms, procedures, policies, and internal documentation as needed.
    • Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of company travel policies and procedures.
    • Assist with travel-related projects and other administrative duties as assigned.
    • Occasionally respond to urgent, time-sensitive travel issues outside of regular business hours on an as-needed basis.

Qualification and Experience

    • Previous experience coordinating corporate travel, travel administration, or administrative support preferred.
    • Experience using an online travel management platform (Navan, Concur, Egencia, or similar) preferred.
    • Knowledge of corporate travel policies, expense management, and travel compliance.
    • Experience working with airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors.
    • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
    • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
    • Strong customer service, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    • Ability to analyze travel costs and identify cost-effective travel solutions.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
    • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.

Physical Requirements

    • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
    • Ability to communicate effectively by phone, email, and virtual meetings.

Additional Responsibilities

    Depending on business needs, this position may also:
    • Create and update SQA associate resumes for recruiting purposes.
    • Review and approve associate timesheets.
    • Assist with administrative support functions as assigned.

SQA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is based on merit and qualifications and is not influenced by race, color, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

This position requires access to ITAR-controlled technical data and/or defense articles. As such, the candidate must be a U.S. citizen or U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder) to comply with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants who do not meet these criteria will not be considered for this role.

At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will be responsible for engaging and qualifying leads through outbound lead funnels in an effort to book high intent meetings for the sales team to convert the sale. This teammate will be engaging with current vacation rental owners through a high volume, high velocity sales cadence.

The ideal candidate for this role will have experience in qualifying leads through building curiosity, following sales scripting, utilizing strategic cadences touch points, and selling the value of a meeting with sales closers The candidate will be required to independently manage a large pipeline through a Sales Engagement/CRM Tool. In addition to base pay, the SDR will be compensated based on key performance metrics while driving new homeowner revenue for Evolve.

What you’ll do

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.

  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Cloud FinOps Consultant is a client-facing role responsible for participating in FinOps implementation projects and managing successful ongoing customer engagement. This person will guide customers in optimizing their cloud consumption with both financial and technical expertise. In addition, this cross-functional role encompasses internal duties such as employee training, service enhancement, and improving upon operational excellence.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Thought Leadership and Industry Best Practices

  • Maintain FinOps Practitioner certification and a strong understanding of current and future FinOps frameworks and best practices.
  • Learn and maintain key knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft CSP, and Google Workspace service offerings and savings vehicles.
  • Align Trace3 FinOps solutions within these frameworks and best practices, working cross-functionally with engineering, business, and consulting teams.

Service Delivery

  • Onboard cloud customers to the appropriate cost management systems and ensure appropriate setup on recurring billing according to contractual specifics.
  • Field and answer cloud customer questions about their billing and overall account within contractual SLAs.
  • Execute FinOps consulting engagements according to specified customer requirements, ensuring on-time delivery of documentation and collateral.
  • Transition consulting engagements into appropriate ongoing services to ensure seamless cloud governance.
  • Foster strong and lasting relationships with key stakeholders and decision makers in the client’s organization to maximize customer success.
  • Design and build cloud FinOps reporting frameworks that satisfy client business needs aligned to tagging and naming strategies.
  • Analyze client cloud cost and usage data to generate optimization opportunities and measure and report results, both identified and realized.
  • Publish regular FinOps activity reports and conduct monthly/quarterly business reviews with clients on results and opportunities.
  • Lead and present in client-facing scenarios with executive audiences, on-site and virtual.

Process Improvement

  • Research, document and implement technical and business enhancements to Trace3’s FinOps service offering and operations with the goal of continually improving customer success.
  • Analyze new cloud provider and third-party tooling options to help in the optimization and automation of internal processes.

Sales Enablement

  • Contribute to the development of new and innovative FinOps consulting services.
  • Build a community and following around Trace3’s company solutions and brand awareness.
  • Formalize internal procedures and collateral for existing and new offerings.
  • Support internal resources and prospects in the pre-sales cycle.

Growth and Strategy

  • Continuously analyze both internal and client-facing processes for opportunities to better scale as the business grows.
  • Participate in tactical and strategic departmental planning to support future growth and team success.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of three years of experience in cloud billing, sales support, operations, managed services, or finance.
  • Experience onboarding clients to cloud billing, cost management, or FinOps tooling.
  • Experience leading client facing presentations.
  • Ability to design and build FinOps reporting frameworks aligned to business and technical requirements.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with customer business, finance and technical teams
  • Ability to efficiently manage and prioritize multiple projects and associated tasks
  • Cloud FinOps Practitioner certification
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 offerings and licensing options
  • Familiarity with Google Workspaces (aka GSuite)
  • Familiarity with cloud concepts for AWS, Azure and/or GCP
  • Knowledge and experience with FinOps concepts and strategies
Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

$85,000—$100,000 USD

The Perks

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Training and development programs
  • Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages
  • Collaborative and cool culture
  • Work-life balance and generous paid time off

Our Commitment

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

**This is a direct hire opportunity with one of our clients. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship now or in the future. **

We're seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of innovative virtual reality applications, web platforms, and educational technology products. This role is ideal for someone with a few years of QA experience who enjoys uncovering issues before they reach users and takes pride in delivering high-quality software experiences.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Developers, Clinical Subject Matter Experts, and fellow QA professionals to validate new features, identify defects, improve testing processes, and support successful product releases. The ideal candidate combines strong manual testing skills with exposure to automation practices and brings a natural curiosity for exploring edge cases and testing beyond expected workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Execute manual testing for web applications, platform features, and virtual reality experiences.

  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.

  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases that validate business requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Investigate and reproduce reported issues, documenting findings with clear and actionable detail.

  • Create and maintain detailed bug reports, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.

  • Validate bug fixes and confirm resolution prior to release.

  • Participate in release readiness activities, testing cycles, and quality sign-offs.

  • Contribute to test automation efforts and help improve overall testing efficiency.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously enhance product quality and user experience.

  • Help maintain testing documentation, standards, and quality assurance best practices.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or a related role.

  • Strong manual testing skills and a solid understanding of software testing methodologies.

  • Experience creating test plans, test cases, and defect documentation.

  • Ability to think critically beyond documented requirements and identify edge cases, risks, and unexpected user behaviors.

  • Experience working within established QA processes and development workflows.

title: Legal Counsel, Emergency Cash & U.S. Programs

raw.title: Legal Counsel, Emergency Cash & U.S. Programs
raw.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
raw.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly is building a faster model for humanitarian response – using data, technology, and partnerships to identify people affected by crises and deliver cash within days. Making that possible requires legal pathways that can be established before a crisis and activated quickly when one occurs.

We are seeking a Counsel to build and lead that legal model. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Emergency Cash, from preparing for future responses to leading the legal and regulatory work required during an active emergency. When a response is underway, EC work will take priority.

You will also serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs, which work with governments, funders, researchers, and community organizations to deliver cash to low-income Americans. The portfolio includes programs such as Rx Kids, guaranteed-income initiatives, and housing-stability programs. You will help teams design and expand these programs, structure partnerships, and navigate the legal issues affecting delivery and recipients.

This is a delivery-focused role for a practical lawyer who can build for scale, exercise clear judgment under pressure, and help ambitious programs move from idea to implementation.

Reports to: Head of Legal

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirement: ~ 3–4 trips per year, plus travel as needed during active emergency responses.

What you’ll do:

Build and deliver the Emergency Cash legal model

  • Serve as the primary legal partner to Emergency Cash across program strategy, design, launch, and delivery.
  • Build a repeatable legal model for emergency responses, including approaches to country entry, regulatory review, government engagement, contracting, data use, and the engagement of local counsel.
  • Develop response-readiness tools, templates, and decision frameworks that allow common issues to be addressed quickly while escalating matters requiring legal judgment.
  • During active responses, lead the legal work needed to launch and operate on emergency timelines, providing clear recommendations when information is incomplete.
  • Coordinate with country teams, program-facing Counsel, and local advisors to use existing knowledge and relationships while retaining legal ownership of the response.
  • Apply GiveDirectly’s global standards for MNO data and remote enablement to individual responses, working with the Corporate & Strategic Affairs Counsel on novel or cross-cutting issues.
  • Draft and negotiate the partnership, technology, vendor, data-sharing, and other agreements required to deliver emergency programs.
  • Capture lessons from individual responses and use them to strengthen the EC legal model over time.

Lead legal support for U.S. programs

  • Serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs across program design, implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations.
  • Advise on the legal design and delivery of U.S. cash programs, including eligible recipient populations, interactions with public benefits, tax treatment and reporting, payments involving minors or caregivers, family-law considerations, privacy and data use, and state-specific requirements.
  • Structure and negotiate program-specific agreements with governments, research institutions, community organizations, payment providers, and other partners.
  • Develop reusable guidance for recurring issues and coordinate state-specific or specialist counsel where needed.

Contribute across Legal

  • Work with the Corporate & Business Affairs Counsel on organization-wide standards and initiatives affecting Emergency Cash or U.S. programs.
  • Partner with the Africa Programs & Country Operations Counsel when emergency responses occur in countries within that role’s portfolio.
  • Work with Legal Operations support to delegate recurring contracting, research, coordination, and administrative work appropriately.
  • Support other priority legal matters as needed as part of a small, global Legal team.

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • Qualification as an attorney in at least one jurisdiction, with relevant post-qualification legal experience.
  • Experience advising on complex program, commercial, or regulatory matters in fast-moving or high-pressure environments.
  • Strong commercial contracting skills, including drafting and negotiating complex partnership, technology, vendor, or data-related agreements.
  • Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar legal and regulatory frameworks and advise where precedent, time, or information is limited.
  • Strong legal and business judgment, including the ability to identify meaningful risks, assess tradeoffs, and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for colleagues without legal backgrounds.
  • Experience coordinating external counsel, consultants, or other specialist advisors.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy and data protection law.
  • Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and reprioritize quickly during active emergency responses.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; English fluency.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience in emergency response, humanitarian operations, or other crisis-context legal work.
    • Experience supporting the launch of programs or operations in new countries.
    • Experience with U.S. public-benefits, family-law, charitable-assistance, or government-program matters.
    • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, particularly in emerging markets.
    • Experience supporting programs involving vulnerable populations or sensitive personal data.
    • Experience in international development or another mission-driven organization.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $134,400
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$13,440, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $15,724 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $147,840+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £91,900
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~£9,190 with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £10,752 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £101,090+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $106,280
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$10,628, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $12,434 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $116,908+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A supportive team that works hard and cares hard
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take
  • Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible application process for all of our open roles. If there are questions or concerns you have about the accessibility of our hiring process, we warmly invite you to reach out to .

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

raw.title: Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are Skyward. That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology.
raw.description:
We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need a Software Engineer who does it all.

Would your friends say you can dissect a complex problem until it quietly gives up? Have you been told (more than once) that you care suspiciously much about modernizing the crusty old systems powering public services ? Good. We’re not bored, we’re impressed.

Here’s the thing: we don’t want an engineer who only writes code and tosses it over the wall. We want the rare one who writes it, automates the pipeline that ships it, and builds the tests that prove it works, and then sleeps soundly because of it. If you believe “done” means tested, deployed, and monitored (not “it runs on my laptop”), then we want you.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Build things that matter.Write effective, scalable code supporting CMS as it merges systems into one AI-driven platform - reducing manual effort, improving data accuracy, and bringing cutting-edge NLP and LLM techniques to public services.
  • Automate all the toil.Own CI/CD pipelines end to end, automating build, test, and deployment workflows with tools like Jenkins, plus Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) so deployments are boring in the best possible way.
  • Test like you mean it.Build and maintain automated test suites - unit, integration, regression - wired straight into the pipeline as quality gates, and provide real test-coverage analysis instead of crossed fingers.
  • Containerize and ship.Package and deploy workloads with Docker (and friends) for repeatable, scalable, what-you-build-is-what-you-run environments.
  • Hunt the bugs.Investigate and debug test failures throughout the lifecycle, update tests or file bugs as needed, and keep the build green and honest.
  • Bake in security.Integrate code-quality checks and security gates (think SonarQube, Snyk) into the pipeline so problems get caught before they ship, not after.
  • Design with humans in mind.Work closely with human-centered design experts to build solutions that are intuitive, responsive, and personalized to each user’s needs.
  • Make things faster.Develop and tune back-end components to improve responsiveness and overall performance.

What we’d like you to have:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong coding chops in Python (and friends).
  • Real DevOps / DevSecOps / DevTestOps experience. You know CI/CD isn’t a buzzword; you’ve actually automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
  • Test automation skill. You’ve built automated tests and integrated them into pipelines with code-quality checks and security gates, not bolted them on at the end.
  • A feel for good pipelines. Scalable, maintainable, and integrated with testing frameworks. You know, the kind that make the whole team faster.
  • Containerization experience (Docker or Kubernetes) and comfort with REST APIs.
  • Fluency in an agile flavor or two - Scrum, Lean, or SAFe.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across a busy mix of stakeholders.

What would blow us away:

  • You’ve got AI chops, experience with NLP, LLMs, or ML-driven applications.
  • You’ve previously supported CMSor another federal agency.
  • Bonus unicorn pointsif you’ve worked inside a FISMA boundary or supported an ATO/cATO effort.

    • Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
  • Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!
At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.
Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.
Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance due to the nature of our work as a government contractor.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Cloud FinOps Consultant is a client-facing role responsible for participating in FinOps implementation projects and managing successful ongoing customer engagement. This person will guide customers in optimizing their cloud consumption with both financial and technical expertise. In addition, this cross-functional role encompasses internal duties such as employee training, service enhancement, and improving upon operational excellence.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Thought Leadership and Industry Best Practices

  • Maintain FinOps Practitioner certification and a strong understanding of current and future FinOps frameworks and best practices.
  • Learn and maintain key knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft CSP, and Google Workspace service offerings and savings vehicles.
  • Align Trace3 FinOps solutions within these frameworks and best practices, working cross-functionally with engineering, business, and consulting teams.

Service Delivery

  • Onboard cloud customers to the appropriate cost management systems and ensure appropriate setup on recurring billing according to contractual specifics.
  • Field and answer cloud customer questions about their billing and overall account within contractual SLAs.
  • Execute FinOps consulting engagements according to specified customer requirements, ensuring on-time delivery of documentation and collateral.
  • Transition consulting engagements into appropriate ongoing services to ensure seamless cloud governance.
  • Foster strong and lasting relationships with key stakeholders and decision makers in the client’s organization to maximize customer success.
  • Design and build cloud FinOps reporting frameworks that satisfy client business needs aligned to tagging and naming strategies.
  • Analyze client cloud cost and usage data to generate optimization opportunities and measure and report results, both identified and realized.
  • Publish regular FinOps activity reports and conduct monthly/quarterly business reviews with clients on results and opportunities.
  • Lead and present in client-facing scenarios with executive audiences, on-site and virtual.

Process Improvement

  • Research, document and implement technical and business enhancements to Trace3’s FinOps service offering and operations with the goal of continually improving customer success.
  • Analyze new cloud provider and third-party tooling options to help in the optimization and automation of internal processes.

Sales Enablement

  • Contribute to the development of new and innovative FinOps consulting services.
  • Build a community and following around Trace3’s company solutions and brand awareness.
  • Formalize internal procedures and collateral for existing and new offerings.
  • Support internal resources and prospects in the pre-sales cycle.

Growth and Strategy

  • Continuously analyze both internal and client-facing processes for opportunities to better scale as the business grows.
  • Participate in tactical and strategic departmental planning to support future growth and team success.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of three years of experience in cloud billing, sales support, operations, managed services, or finance.
  • Experience onboarding clients to cloud billing, cost management, or FinOps tooling.
  • Experience leading client facing presentations.
  • Ability to design and build FinOps reporting frameworks aligned to business and technical requirements.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with customer business, finance and technical teams
  • Ability to efficiently manage and prioritize multiple projects and associated tasks
  • Cloud FinOps Practitioner certification
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 offerings and licensing options
  • Familiarity with Google Workspaces (aka GSuite)
  • Familiarity with cloud concepts for AWS, Azure and/or GCP
  • Knowledge and experience with FinOps concepts and strategies
Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

$85,000—$100,000 USD

The Perks

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Training and development programs
  • Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages
  • Collaborative and cool culture
  • Work-life balance and generous paid time off

Our Commitment

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

We're seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of innovative virtual reality applications, web platforms, and educational technology products. This role is ideal for someone with a few years of QA experience who enjoys uncovering issues before they reach users and takes pride in delivering high-quality software experiences.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Developers, Clinical Subject Matter Experts, and fellow QA professionals to validate new features, identify defects, improve testing processes, and support successful product releases. Responsibilities

  • Execute manual testing for web applications, platform features, and virtual reality experiences.

  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.

  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases that validate business requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Investigate and reproduce reported issues, documenting findings with clear and actionable detail.

  • Create and maintain detailed bug reports, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.

  • Validate bug fixes and confirm resolution prior to release.

  • Participate in release readiness activities, testing cycles, and quality sign-offs.

  • Contribute to test automation efforts and help improve overall testing efficiency.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously enhance product quality and user experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or a related role.

  • Strong manual testing skills and a solid understanding of software testing methodologies.

  • Experience creating test plans, test cases, and defect documentation.

  • Ability to think critically beyond documented requirements and identify edge cases, risks, and unexpected user behaviors.

  • Experience working within established QA processes and development workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to learn new tools, technologies, and business domains quickly.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to test automation tools, frameworks, or automation best practices. Experience is more important than a specific toolset, and candidates who have explored AI-assisted automation approaches are encouraged to apply.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to assist with test creation, automation, or QA workflows.

  • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Linear, or similar issue-tracking platforms.

  • Experience testing web-based applications, SaaS platforms, or mobile applications.

  • Familiarity with virtual reality devices such as Meta Quest, HTC Vive, or similar hardware.

  • Exposure to mobile device management (MDM) platforms and device testing.

  • Strong "test around the object" mindset with the ability to identify issues beyond defined requirements and expected workflows.

  • Interest in healthcare technology, simulation, education technology, or emerging technologies.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

raw.description:
Inside Sales Representative (ISR) – Full-Cycle B2B & SaaS Sales | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours — aligned with prospect time zones

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) to own the full remote sales cycle — from prospecting and lead qualification through discovery, product demos, negotiation, and closing.

This is a true revenue-generating sales role, not a lead handoff position.

You’ll own:

  • Prospecting
  • Lead qualification
  • Discovery calls
  • Product demos
  • Follow-ups
  • Objection handling
  • Closing
  • Pipeline management

If you’re competitive, consultative, comfortable with outbound sales, and motivated by quotas and revenue targets, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Lead Generation

Respond quickly to inbound opportunities from:

  • Marketing campaigns
  • Website inquiries
  • Referrals

Proactively generate outbound opportunities through:

  • LinkedIn
  • Cold calling
  • Email outreach
  • CRM prospecting

Research accounts and decision-makers before outreach and personalize messaging based on the prospect’s industry, business needs, and pain points.

Discovery & Qualification

Run structured discovery calls with prospects and decision-makers.

Use qualification and sales methodologies such as:

  • BANT
  • SPIN
  • MEDDIC
  • Challenger

You’ll:

  • Identify business challenges and pain points
  • Understand buying intent and priorities
  • Qualify opportunities
  • Uncover decision-making criteria
  • Position solutions around prospect needs
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally

Product Demos & Sales Presentations

Conduct virtual product demonstrations and sales presentations.

Clearly communicate:

  • Product/service value
  • Relevant use cases
  • Business impact
  • ROI
  • Differentiators

Tailor each conversation to the prospect instead of relying on generic presentations.

Negotiation & Closing

Own opportunities through the final stages of the sales process.

You’ll:

  • Follow up consistently
  • Address objections
  • Send proposals
  • Negotiate pricing and terms within approved guidelines
  • Move opportunities toward close
  • Convert qualified prospects into customers

After closing, ensure a smooth handoff to onboarding, Customer Success, or Account Management.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate records in platforms such as:

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM

Track:

  • Opportunity stages
  • Prospect interactions
  • Follow-ups
  • Next steps
  • Forecasts
  • Deal progression

Maintain strong pipeline hygiene and ensure opportunities never go stale due to missed follow-ups.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Sales leadership
  • Marketing
  • Solutions consultants
  • Account Managers
  • Customer Success teams

Provide feedback on:

  • Lead quality
  • Prospect objections
  • Messaging
  • Competitors
  • Market insights
  • Conversion barriers

Use performance data and prospect feedback to continuously improve outreach, discovery, and closing strategies.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are confident speaking with decision-makers
  • Can prospect and close rather than only handling one stage of the funnel
  • Are comfortable with cold outreach
  • Run structured, consultative discovery conversations
  • Handle objections without becoming overly aggressive
  • Know how to communicate value and ROI
  • Follow up consistently
  • Maintain an organized pipeline
  • Are motivated by quotas, revenue, and measurable performance
  • Can independently manage a remote sales cycle

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Inside Sales
    • SDR / BDR
    • Business Development
    • Full-cycle sales
  • Proven experience managing a remote sales cycle
  • Track record of hitting or exceeding sales quotas
  • Experience with:
    • Prospecting
    • Cold calling
    • Discovery
    • Product demos
    • Objection handling
    • Negotiation
    • Closing
  • Experience with CRMs such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms such as:
    • Outreach
    • Salesloft
    • Apollo
  • Strong virtual presentation skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Strong pipeline management and follow-up discipline
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

Experience selling:

  • SaaS
  • B2B solutions
  • Marketing services
  • Professional services

Experience selling into:

  • SMBs
  • Mid-market companies

Familiarity with:

  • SPIN Selling
  • MEDDIC
  • Challenger
  • BANT

Experience with longer, relationship-driven, or consultative B2B sales cycles is also valuable.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might:

  • Review your pipeline and prioritize active opportunities
  • Respond quickly to new inbound leads
  • Prospect through phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Conduct discovery calls
  • Deliver virtual demos and presentations
  • Follow up with active opportunities
  • Handle objections and send proposals
  • Negotiate and close deals
  • Update CRM records and forecasts
  • Collaborate with sales leadership on pipeline progress
  • Review KPIs and improve conversion performance

In short: You generate revenue by taking prospects from initial conversation through qualification, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly quota attainment
  • Closed revenue
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Discovery calls completed
  • Product demos completed
  • Average deal size
  • Pipeline velocity
  • Sales cycle length
  • Forecast accuracy
  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of the sales cycle
  • Direct impact on company revenue
  • Strong earning and performance potential
  • Exposure to modern B2B sales systems
  • Opportunity to strengthen:
    • Prospecting
    • Discovery
    • Consultative selling
    • Negotiation
    • Closing
    • Pipeline management
  • Fully remote environment
  • Career growth into:
    • Senior ISR
    • Account Executive
    • Senior Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Revenue Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Sales Task – Discovery Call / Email Sequence
  5. Client Interview with Sales Leadership
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Enjoy prospecting and closing deals
  • Are confident running discovery calls and demos
  • Know how to handle objections and communicate value
  • Thrive in quota-driven B2B sales environments
  • Want full ownership of your pipeline and revenue results

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and take ownership of the complete sales journey — from first conversation to closed deal.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role


We are seeking a Clinical Research Manager (CRM) to join our team in a home-based capacity in France. As a Clinical Research Manager, you will play a pivotal role in the successful delivery of complex oncology clinical trials for a top pharmaceutical client.


This position is responsible for the end-to-end management and performance of assigned protocols, ensuring compliance with ICH-GCP, local regulations, client requirements, and quality standards.

Working across study start-up, maintenance, and close-out, you will provide strategic oversight of trial execution, site performance, vendor management, and CRA activities. You will collaborate with cross functional partners, drive operational excellence, and help ensure that innovative therapies reach patients efficiently and safely.


You will join a fast paced, growth-oriented environment where your expertise directly contributes to the advancement of life changing treatments. With exposure to global stakeholders, leadership opportunities, and continuous development, this role offers a strong platform for career progression within clinical research and project leadership.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead end to end performance and project management of assigned clinical trial protocols in compliance with ICH-GCP, local regulations, and client requirements
  • Manage study start-up activities, including oversight of site selection strategies, monitoring plans, and trial planning tools
  • Review and contribute to patient recruitment and retention strategies to support study delivery objectives
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and direction to project team members across multiple locations and functions
  • Evaluate project resource requirements and monitor resource utilization throughout the study lifecycle
  • Address and resolve site issues, ensuring timely escalation and successful closure of identified risks
  • Monitor study timelines, patient recruitment, retention, and data cleaning activities to support successful project outcomes
  • Maintain oversight of quality standards and ensure appropriate follow up of quality related issues
  • Drive process improvements that enhance study efficiency and operational performance
  • Contribute to revenue recognition forecasting and project planning activities, as required
  • Collaborate with project teams on database lock activities and study close-out deliverables
  • Ensure completion of all administrative close-out procedures, study archiving activities, and client documentation requirements

Candidate Profile


You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and project coordination skills
  • Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
  • The ability to collaborate across cross functional and global teams while communicating effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • A patient focused mindset and commitment to quality, compliance, and operational excellence
  • Comfort working with clinical trial systems, study management processes, and project planning tools

Required Qualifications


  • Degree in a life science, nursing qualification, or relevant clinical and/or clinical management experience
  • Substantial experience in clinical research, including relevant experience as a team leader in clinical functions or proven experience coordinating clinical trials
  • Previous experience as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA)
  • Experience in oncology clinical trials
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, SOPs, and clinical trial processes
  • Experience managing clinical trial activities, study operations, site oversight, and vendor relationships
  • Strong communication, organization, leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong command of written and spoken English language

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience within a pharmaceutical company, healthcare organization, or contract research organization
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies and clinical study lifecycle management

Benefits and Compensation


  • Medical Plan
  • Life Assurance
  • Pension

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes life assurance and medical plan, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.


If this job doesn’t sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who’d be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

Semarchy is looking for a Junior Site Reliability Engineer to help keep our SaaS products and infrastructure reliable and scalable. Reporting to the VP of IT Operations and Security, you'll work alongside senior engineers, software developers and support teams to keep our systems running well and available.

This is a great role for someone with a few years of hands-on cloud or DevOps experience who wants to grow their SRE skills in a production SaaS environment.

What You'll Do

1. Reliability and Availability
  • Help build and maintain systems that support high availability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery across our cloud environments.
  • Track SLOs and SLIs for critical services, and help improve them over time.
2. Infrastructure and Automation
  • Write and maintain automation scripts and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) to cut down on manual operational work.
  • Set up and tune monitoring, alerting and logging so issues get caught early.
  • Follow security and change-management practices that support our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments.
  • Help remediate vulnerabilities and keep infrastructure patched and hardened.
3. Incident Response and Post-Mortems
  • Take part in on-call rotations, with support from senior team members, to respond to incidents and outages.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and follow through on the actions that prevent repeat issues.
  • Write and keep up-to-date documentation and runbooks.
4. Performance and Cost
  • Monitor system performance, capacity and cloud spend, and flag areas to optimize.
  • Help carry out capacity upgrades and performance improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3 years in an SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure or similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., EC2, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers (Docker, Helm a plus).

  • Familiarity with monitoring, alerting and logging tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
