About Us

Cadence () is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.

Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.

You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.

Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.

Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.

The Job

You will manage multiple projects per day.

Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).

Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).

Here’s how you will interact with a project:

Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus

Working Hours & Location

  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH)
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours, but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses
Salary: Commensurate with experience

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Role Overview

The Customer Account Manager (CAM) is a strategic, relationship-driven role focused on managing and growing GE Aerospace’s partnership with Lockheed Martin Aeronautics (LM Aero). The CAM is accountable for all aspects of the LM Aero airframer relationship, including day-to-day engagement and strategy for future growth opportunities.

This role identifies and develops sales and growth opportunities, shapes future campaigns, translates customer needs into clear strategies, and drives change across GE Aerospace and LM Aero teams. This position is ideal for candidates with a strong background in Aerospace & Defense markets and strategic account management, who are comfortable navigating complex organizations and engaging with senior leadership.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Own the LM Aero relationship from the C-suite down, facilitating senior GE Aerospace leadership engagement to win business and deepen long term partnership.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the customer’s vision, business model, portfolio, regional market, and competitors, as well as GE Aerospace’s business priorities and growth initiatives.
  • Lead strategic account planning with LM Aero and GE Aerospace stakeholders, including clear growth objectives, value propositions, and joint action plans.
  • Engage across GE Aerospace P&Ls, Strategy & Business Development, and other functions to align priorities, ensure consistent messaging, and optimize business outcomes.
  • Represent the voice of the customer in capture teams, ensuring GE Aerospace offerings are differentiated and aligned to LM Aero’s needs and decision-drivers.
  • Lead pre-positioning of key opportunities, influence airframer needs, and drive activities leading up to Intent to Order and formal campaigns.
  • Proactively engage in GE Aerospace / LM Aero business issues; be a visible, trusted member of the customer interface teams, helping to solve problems and preserve strong relationships.
  • Translate strategic growth priorities into executable plans that expand business with LM Aero and associated customer sets.
  • Support executive engagement at tradeshows, conferences, summits, and executive management reviews to advance GE Aerospace’s position with LM Aero and key stakeholders.
  • Ethically source and synthesize competitive intelligence to inform strategy in alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and GE Aerospace policies.
  • Travel as required by the business (approximately 15% - 25%)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in direct sales, business development, and/or account management within the Aviation or Defense industry

This role will require in-person attendance for New Hire Orientation on Day 1.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated credibility engaging directly with customers
  • Experience presenting strategies and complex information to both peers and senior level leadership
  • Strong customer mindset with a proven ability to engage customers, understand their problem statements, and develop strategies to deliver solutions and value
  • Solid understanding of the Defense market, including airframer, competitor, and supplier positions in technology and product strategy
  • Working knowledge of Department of Defense budgeting and acquisition processes and the ability to relate them to customer decision cycles
  • Existing security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one
  • Ability to travel as required by the business

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus in our Field Services department as an Instructional Designer/Consultant. You will support the development of client-facing training and readiness solutions. You will collaborate with internal team leadership and various SMEs to structure content and deliver effective solutions that drive success in client initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop instructional or enablement content tailored to the specific needs of the client.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) and stakeholders to identify learning objectives, gather content, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Develop interactive e-learning courses using instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) and adult learning theories.
  • Design assessments and knowledge checks to measure learner progress, retention, and content effectiveness.
  • Review and refine instructional materials based on stakeholder feedback and learner outcomes.
  • Translate complex technical, operational, and business processes into clear, practical, field-ready content.
  • Refine broadly defined client needs into structured, usable learning and performance support solutions
  • Work with limited direct access to SMEs, leveraging available resources, internal support, and iterative development approaches
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities, feedback, and client constraints throughout the development process
  • Build deliverables that are both training solutions and practical reference tools for real-world use
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, client-driven environment where priorities, requirements, and stakeholder feedback may evolve throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Balance quality, timelines, and stakeholder expectations while delivering practical, learner-focused solutions.
  • Create and update e-learning content, graphics, presentations, process documentation, and performance support materials using approved development tools, templates, and creativity within brand guidelines.
  • Use available tools, including AI-supported workflows, to improve efficiency and support content development

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience developing training, instructional content, or performance support materials.
  • Minimum 4-6 years of instructional design experience, specifically focused on e-learning content creation.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience developing instructional content using e-learning authoring tools, multimedia software, or related content development platforms (e.g., Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools).
  • Strong ability to translate complex subject matter into clear, engaging, and learner-focused content.
  • Ability to plan, organize, and manage work effectively within agile or iterative workflows while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable collaborating with SMEs and cross-functional teams.
  • Portfolio demonstrating instructional design, e-learning development, graphic design, presentation design, or related content development work.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 1,800 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

raw.title: Manager/Lead, Salesforce Administration
raw.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to lead the day-to-day stewardship and continued evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem.
raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to lead the day-to-day stewardship and continued evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will guide and develop a team, own critical platform controls, and remain directly involved in the design, configuration, release and support of business-critical solutions.

The role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of our Salesforce estate, with particular focus on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the APIs and integrations that connect Salesforce to Slack and other enterprise platforms. You will balance rapid delivery with strong governance, helping the organisation get more value from Salesforce without increasing operational or security risk.

What you will be accountable for

1. Team leadership and operating model

  • Lead and develop the Salesforce team, setting clear priorities, standards and expectations while creating an environment of ownership, learning and constructive challenge.

  • Act as the senior escalation point, providing calm, evidence-led direction during incidents, complex delivery decisions and stakeholder conflicts.

  • Shape the team operating model, including capacity planning, work allocation, skills development, recruitment support and the effective use of specialist partners.

  • Build sustainable capability, through coaching, documentation, peer review and reducing dependency on individual team members or external suppliers.

2. Salesforce platform ownership

  • Own the health and evolution of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring the platform supports commercial, customer-service and operational processes effectively.

  • Set and enforce platform standards, covering configuration, automation, data models, naming conventions, documentation, testing and technical debt.

  • Remain hands-on where needed, including complex Flow automation, permissions, validation rules, objects, page layouts, Lightning pages, reports, dashboards, analytics and troubleshooting.

  • Own day-to-day system administration, including user administration, joiner/mover/leaver processing, delegated administration and routine platform hygiene.

  • Configure and maintain Experience Cloud portals, including external sharing rules, guest user access, community settings, and partner- or customer-facing experiences.

  • Maintain a clear platform roadmap that balances strategic improvements, regulatory or security obligations, operational resilience, and business demand.

  • Control platform lifecycle changes, including Salesforce seasonal releases, feature adoption, deprecations, sandbox strategy and environment management.

  • Evaluate and deploy AppExchange packages, assessing them against business requirements, security review status, licence cost, support model and long-term maintainability.

3. Integrations, APIs and operational monitoring

  • Own the operational oversight of Salesforce integrations, including interfaces with Slack and other core enterprise applications.

  • Administer and maintain key business integrations.

  • Establish effective Slack API monitoring to cover authentication failures, token or certificate expirations, API errors, rate limits, latency, message delivery failures, and unexpected usage patterns.

  • Define monitoring and alerting standards, with meaningful thresholds, named owners, support runbooks, escalation paths and service-level expectations.

  • Protect integration reliability by overseeing connected apps, OAuth scopes, named credentials, integration users, event-driven services and API consumption.

  • Lead incident response and problem management, ensuring root causes are understood, corrective actions are completed and recurring failures are designed out.

4. Security, access and control posture

  • Own the Salesforce security posture, working with Security, IT and Risk teams to maintain proportionate, auditable controls.

  • Design and maintain the org-wide sharing and security architecture, including organisation-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets and permission-set groups, and field-level security.

  • Apply least-privilege access, with appropriate segregation of duties and regular remediation of accumulated or excessive entitlements.

  • Govern identities and privileged access, including SSO and MFA (working knowledge of Okta or a comparable identity provider), service accounts, integration users, delegated administration and joiner/mover/leaver controls.

  • Lead regular security audits and access reviews to evidence least-privilege compliance and drive timely remediation of findings.

  • Partner with IT and Security on platform audits and compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR obligations, control evidence and audit response.

  • Review platform risk signals, such as login anomalies, API usage, configuration changes, installed packages and connected-app behaviour, using the monitoring capabilities available in the Salesforce estate.

  • Protect sensitive information through sound data-access design, retention controls, masking or anonymisation in non-production environments, and responsible vendor access.

5. Licensing, certificates and lifecycle management

  • Optimise licence usage and forecasting across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including reharvesting, right-sizing and renewal input.

  • Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles, including SSL and SAML signing certificates, to prevent avoidable authentication or integration outages.

  • Manage connected app and OAuth lifecycles, with a maintained inventory, named owners, expiry tracking and proactive renewal ahead of failure.

  • Provide clear cost and entitlement visibility, so licence, package and integration spend is understood, challenged and aligned to realised value.

6. Delivery, release and DevOps

  • Own a transparent and prioritised delivery backlog, working with business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, value, dependencies and acceptance criteria.

  • Maintain disciplined release management, with source control, peer review, automated or repeatable deployment, regression testing, rollback planning and release communications.

  • Execute version-controlled releases through GitHub, using branch strategy, pull requests, peer approval and traceable change history as the standard route to production.

  • Maintain documentation for all configuration and change management, so the estate remains understandable, auditable and supportable by more than one person.

  • Improve platform support, using clear service measures, triage processes, knowledge articles, problem records and trend analysis.

  • Manage technical debt deliberately, making risks and trade-offs visible and ensuring remediation is planned alongside new demand.

  • Partner effectively with vendors, holding delivery partners to clear outcomes, quality standards, documentation and knowledge-transfer commitments.

7. Data quality and platform insight

  • Champion trustworthy Salesforce data, including ownership, validation, duplicate management, integration reconciliation and remediation of recurring data-quality issues.

  • Provide actionable platform insight, using dashboards and regular reporting on adoption, automation failures, API consumption, incidents, release quality, access risk and technical debt.

  • Support sound architecture decisions, challenging unnecessary customisation and promoting maintainable, scalable use of standard Salesforce capabilities and enterprise-level data modelling.

8. AI, Agentforce and emerging capabilities

  • Help evaluate and safely adopt Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and adjacent enterprise AI tools where they can improve employee or customer outcomes.

  • Support responsible AI governance, including data access, grounding, human oversight, prompt and agent testing, monitoring, auditability and change control.

  • Contribute practical experience with Claude or comparable models, especially where AI services interact with Salesforce, Slack, knowledge content, workflows or customer data.

  • Separate experimentation from production readiness, ensuring AI-enabled solutions meet the same security, reliability and support standards as other business-critical capabilities.

Leadership behaviours

  • Service-minded ownership: you treat Salesforce as a critical business service, not simply a collection of projects.

  • Wise pragmatism: you balance speed, usability, maintainability, cost and risk rather than optimising for only one dimension.

  • Constructive challenge: you can say no, or not yet, with clear evidence and a practical route forward.

  • Calm accountability: you take ownership when problems arise without creating blame or hiding uncomfortable facts.

  • Enabling leadership: you give people clarity and support while building their confidence, judgement and independence.

  • Clear communication: you make technical issues understandable and keep stakeholders informed before uncertainty becomes surprise.

Key working relationships

The role will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Security, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Data and Integration teams, as well as Salesforce and specialist implementation partners.

Essential

  • 7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in large, multi-team environments, with substantial hands-on responsibility for administration, configuration and operational support in a complex production environment.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification (required).

  • Proven people leadership, including line management, coaching, performance support, work prioritisation and development of Salesforce administrators or platform specialists.

  • Deep practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including their security, automation, data and service-management implications.

  • Deep Salesforce security expertise, covering organisation-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing models, permission sets, field-level security, identity, privileged access, connected apps and audit controls.

  • Hands-on Experience Cloud capability, including external sharing models, guest access and community configuration.

  • Proven Salesforce DevOps and change-management experience using GitHub, including version-controlled deployment workflows, pull-request review and release governance.

  • Experience operating API-led integrations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, authentication, limits, failure handling and coordination across technical teams.

  • Experience managing SSL and authentication certificates and maintaining integration health.

  • Strong declarative delivery capability, particularly Flow, data modelling, validation, Lightning configuration, reporting and environment management.

  • Sound release and change-management experience, including sandbox strategy, source control, testing, deployment governance and production support.

  • Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to translate between commercial priorities, user needs, technical constraints and risk.

  • Strong solution and design judgement, with a good understanding of platform architecture and enterprise-level data modelling.

Desirable

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification (preferred), or other relevant credentials such as Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant or an appropriate Agentforce/AI accreditation.

  • Experience administering Ironclad, Qualtrics and Slack CRM / Sales Elevate, or directly comparable CLM, survey and Slack-CRM tooling.

  • Agentforce or Salesforce AI experience, including agent design, grounding, guardrails, evaluation or operational monitoring.

  • Experience with Claude or other enterprise AI platforms, particularly in governed, data-sensitive business workflows.

  • Experience with Slack platform capabilities and APIs, including enterprise integrations, apps, workflows, authentication and observability.

  • Working knowledge of Okta or a comparable enterprise identity provider.

  • Exposure to complementary enterprise platforms, such as NetSuite, MuleSoft, Celigo, Boomi, Workato, Zapier, identity providers or data platforms.

  • Experience in a SaaS, technology or high-growth environment, where Salesforce supports complex B2B go-to-market and customer-service processes

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

raw.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon's multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon's collaborative workflows.

The Role

Pantheon's Security Engineering team is responsible for safeguarding, auditing, and testing the security of Pantheon's entire platform. Our Security Engineering team aims to create a comprehensive and multi-dimensional approach to application security, with a focus on Security by Design in agile software development and cloud native environments.

We are seeking a Security Engineer II to join our growing team. This role bridges execution and tooling — you'll own security domains end-to-end while building the automation and processes that multiply the team's impact across engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write detection rules, build vulnerability management tooling, implement supply chain security controls, and develop the automation pipelines that make security scale.

Our mission is to safeguard, audit, and test the security of the entire cloud hosting platform in these core areas:

  • Security by Design: Implement "Security by Design" within agile software development and cloud-native environments.
  • Security Tooling & Automation: Build and maintain security tooling and automation that scales the team's impact beyond what manual processes can achieve.
  • Support and Mentorship: Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), mentoring and supporting security engineering efforts across the organization.
  • Standard Setting: Contribute to application security policy, process, standards, and guidelines — and build the tooling that enforces them.
  • Application Security Performance: Help engineering teams design and build high-performing, secure applications by mitigating security issues in a risk-based manner.

What You Will Do

  • Detection Engineering: Author SIEM detection rules and response playbooks in Chronicle / Google SecOps (YARA-L), expanding coverage across Pantheon's security monitoring surface.
  • Security Tooling Development: Build and maintain security automation pipelines (Python/Go) — vulnerability management tooling (vulntools, Wiz scripts), GHAS automation, and CI/CD security integrations.
  • Vulnerability Management: Own vulnerability identification, triage, and remediation coordination with engineering squads across application (SAST/DAST/SCA) and infrastructure layers.
  • Supply Chain Security: Implement supply chain security controls (Aikido, SLSA, dependency pinning) and integrate them into engineering workflows.
  • Access & Identity: Execute RBAC cleanup, access architecture implementation, and periodic user access reviews. Manage GitHub org-level security policies and access controls.
  • Cloud Security: Execute CSPM baseline findings triage, cloud security baseline validation, and data warehouse security implementation (Snowflake).
  • DLP & Secrets: Define DLP policies and evaluate tooling; execute credential and secrets hygiene programs (plaintext credential remediation in repositories).

What You Need to Succeed

  • Builder Orientation: You measure impact by what you ship — tooling that engineering teams adopt, automation that replaces manual work, detection rules that catch real threats. Not by tickets closed or alerts triaged.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills essential for partnering with engineering teams across the organization. You advocate for security priorities and tradeoffs across functions without being prompted.
  • Commitment: Demonstrated commitment to teamwork, professionalism, and authenticity, fostering trust and accountability.
  • Grit: Understanding that establishing security best practices is a marathon requiring persistence across many stakeholders.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Overall Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of overall experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to Application Security or Security Engineering.
  • Security Tooling: Demonstrated experience building security automation — vulnerability management scripts, CI/CD pipeline integrations, detection rules, or similar tooling that engineering teams use in production.
  • Development Practices: Hands-on experience with Secure by Design development practices, including participating in security architecture and design reviews.
  • Cloud Proficiency: Experience securing production systems in cloud environments (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure also valuable).
  • Coding Proficiency: Ability to build maintainable components in Python or Go. You write tools, not just policies.
  • CI/CD Fundamentals: Hands-on experience with Jenkins, Cloud Build, CircleCI, or similar (bonus points for experience with reusable workflows).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Experience working with containerization (e.g., Docker, OCI), Terraform, and Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Security Tooling Platforms: Experience with SAST/DAST/SCA/CSPM tools. Familiarity with CodeQL, Wiz, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree (preferred) in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays
  • Comprehensive medical insurance including Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid parental leave (plus fertility, adoption and other family planning benefits)
  • In-office workspace (San Francisco & Chicago)
  • Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
  • Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate

Compensation: CAD $94,000 - 118,0000 annual salary plus bonus and equity

After an offer is made and accepted, E-verify will be utilized to establish your identity and employment eligibility as required by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

Accounting Manager

Remote – United States | Brooklyn, NY or Burlington, VT

About the Role

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to build a cleaner, more distributed energy future — helping consumers turn smart thermostats, EVs, and batteries into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and expand renewable capacity.

We're looking for an Accounting Manager to join a growing Finance team at a pivotal moment in EnergyHub's evolution. This is a role for a technically rigorous accountant who brings precision and depth to everything they touch — someone who is energized by complexity and holds the work to an uncompromising standard. You'll own the month-end close end-to-end, serve as the technical anchor of the accounting function, and have genuine influence over how our processes and reporting evolve. You'll work within a structure set by our parent company, Alarm.com (Nasdaq: ALRM), while building something that truly serves EnergyHub.

If you're passionate about technical accounting, ready to take real ownership, and want your work to matter beyond the close, this role was written for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own EnergyHub's month-end and quarter-end close — journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules prepared with accuracy and on time, within the broader schedule set by Alarm.com corporate accounting
  • Evaluate and redesign the close process from the ground up, building scalable, repeatable workflows and the documentation and controls to support them
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or judgmental accounting matters, including revenue recognition under ASC 606
  • Partner with Alarm.com corporate accounting as EnergyHub's primary close liaison — meeting their standards for accuracy, documentation, and deadlines while translating requirements back to the EnergyHub team in a way that supports rather than impedes the business
  • Partner with EnergyHub's internal teams — operations, customer success, FP&A — to provide the accounting guidance, context, and information they need to make better decisions
  • Play a key role in EnergyHub's ERP migration — a multi-year initiative that will reshape how the accounting function operates — in partnership with Finance leadership and the broader Alarm.com project team
  • Take on additional projects as business needs evolve — this team is growing and the scope of this role will grow with it

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting
  • Active CPA license
  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting and close experience in a public company environment
  • Deep, working knowledge of U.S. GAAP — you find the technical side of accounting genuinely interesting, not just necessary
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process gaps and build scalable solutions
  • Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience redesigning and implementing a close process and/or building management reporting packages from the ground up
  • Experience in SaaS, software, energy, or tech
  • Experience with multi-entity consolidation or a subsidiary/parent company reporting structure
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains)

How You'll Work

You hold the work to an uncompromising standard and bring deep technical knowledge to every judgment call. You don't cut corners, and you don't let ambiguity become an excuse for imprecision. When something doesn't look right, you dig in. When a policy or requirement seems unclear to a colleague, you explain the why — because you know that understanding drives better outcomes than compliance alone.

You understand that accounting doesn't happen in a vacuum. You're equally comfortable navigating the precision and rigor that a corporate accounting team demands and translating complex requirements into plain language for a team of non-accountants who need context, not just answers. You see your role as building something that supports the business — not policing it.

You're energized by the challenge of walking into a complex environment and making it better. You don't need a perfect environment to do excellent work — you build the environment.

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

Why work for EnergyHub?

  • Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
  • Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
  • Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
  • Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.
  • Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate.

About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

To learn more, visit energyhub.com.

Company Benefits

EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.

EnergyHub is an Equal Opportunity Employer

EOE, Including Disability/Vets. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact .

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

Notice To Third Party Agencies:

EnergyHub understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you.

The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

raw.description:
About us

Wazo builds programmable, API-first communication infrastructure and applications.

We power unified communications at the infrastructure level:

real-time systems, SIP signaling, WebRTC, media flows, distributed services, and high-availability architectures and applications based on those.

This is not feature-layer work.

This is mission-critical telecom infrastructure.

Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire systems engineers who can reason about complex, evolving environments. We expect strong depth in at least one domain, and the curiosity to operate beyond it as the system demands. If you prefer working strictly within a single framework or language, this role may feel constrained.

Our current environment includes:

  • Backend services primarily in Python
  • Mobile core in Kotlin and Swift
  • Real-time infrastructure components across multiple technologies

Familiarity matters less than your ability to learn quickly, write maintainable systems code, and protect operational integrity. Technology choices evolve. System thinking does not.

The Role

You will work on:

  • SIP / VoIP signaling
  • RTP media flows
  • Distributed backend systems
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Low-level networking and performance-sensitive components
  • AI-augmented engineering workflows

You will contribute across layers — from protocol handling to API orchestration.

You will own:

  • Architecture: clean interfaces between protocol handling, media, and API layers
  • Reliability & operability: instrumentation, debugging, incident follow-ups, hardening
  • Performance: latency, throughput, resource usage, media path efficiency

AI-Native Engineering

We operate with an agent-centric model. AI is used to accelerate execution (drafts, refactors, tests, runbooks), but humans own correctness.

You will provide direction, constraints, validation, and long-term coherence. You will set constraints, review outputs critically, and ensure changes align with long-term architecture. AI assists with drafting, refactoring, tests, and documentation.

The bottleneck is judgment.

We are looking for engineers who can supervise quality, protect architectural integrity, and make sound trade-offs at scale

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of professional experience(6–10 considered for exceptional system-level profiles)
  • Strong system thinking is required
  • Experience in distributed or real-time systems
  • Comfort near infrastructure layers
  • Autonomous, high-ownership mindset
  • Product awareness
  • Telecom experience is a plus. Systems thinking is essential.
  • Engineering school background
  • Based in Europe.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation and benefits for this role are calibrated against the specific local market standards to ensure competitive alignment with regional cost-of-labor and talent benchmarks

We reward depth, ownership, and architectural impact.

Benefits offered

  • Comprehensive benefits package covered by the employer
  • Competitive salary
  • Remote work
  • Friendly culture with great opportunities to make an impact on a growing global team.

Why Join

  • Fast growing and changing environment
  • AI-native engineering model
  • Infrastructure-level challenges
  • High autonomy
  • Senior, high-density team

If you value judgment, system integrity, and meaningful technical impact — we should talk.

À propos de nous

Wazo construit une infrastructure et des applications de communication programmables, API-first.

Nous opérons les communications unifiées au niveau de l’infrastructure :

systèmes temps réel, signalisation SIP, WebRTC, flux média, services distribués, et architectures hautement disponibles ainsi que les applications qui en découlent.

Il ne s’agit pas de développement de fonctionnalités en surface.

Il s’agit d’infrastructure télécom critique.

Notre philosophie de recrutement

Nous recrutons des développeurs systèmes capables de raisonner dans des environnements complexes et en constante évolution. Nous attendons une forte expertise dans au moins un domaine, ainsi qu’une curiosité à opérer au-delà de celui-ci en fonction des besoins du système. Si vous préférez travailler strictement dans un cadre limité à un langage ou un framework, ce rôle peut ne pas vous convenir.

Notre environnement actuel inclut :

  • Services backend principalement en Python
  • Noyau mobile en Kotlin et Swift
  • Composants d’infrastructure temps réel sur plusieurs technologies

La familiarité avec une stack importe moins que votre capacité à apprendre rapidement, écrire du code maintenable, et préserver l’intégrité opérationnelle. Les technologies évoluent. La pensée système, elle, reste.

Le rôle

Vous travaillerez sur :

  • Signalisation SIP / VoIP
  • Flux média RTP
  • Systèmes backend distribués
  • Architectures event-driven
  • Composants réseau bas niveau et sensibles à la performance
  • Workflows d’ingénierie augmentés par l’IA

Vous contribuerez sur l’ensemble de la stack, du traitement protocolaire jusqu’à l’orchestration via API.

Vous serez responsable de :

  • Architecture : interfaces propres entre couches protocole, média et API
  • Fiabilité & opérabilité : instrumentation, debugging, gestion des incidents, durcissement
  • Performance : latence, débit, utilisation des ressources, efficacité des chemins média

Ingénierie AI-Native

Nous opérons selon un modèle centré sur les agents. L’IA est utilisée pour accélérer l’exécution (drafts, refactorings, tests, runbooks), mais les humains restent responsables de la justesse.

Vous apporterez direction, contraintes, validation et cohérence long terme. Vous définirez les garde-fous, évaluerez les productions de manière critique, et vous assurerez que les évolutions respectent l’architecture globale. L’IA assiste sur la production de code, les tests et la documentation.

Le goulot d’étranglement est le jugement.

Nous recherchons des développeurs capables de superviser la qualité, protéger l’intégrité architecturale et prendre des décisions pertinentes à l’échelle.

Profil recherché

  • 10+ années d’expérience professionnelle (6–10 ans pour des profils systèmes exceptionnels)
  • Forte capacité de raisonnement système
  • Expérience en systèmes distribués ou temps réel
  • À l’aise proche des couches infrastructure
  • Forte autonomie et sens des responsabilités
  • Sens produit
  • Une expérience télécom est un plus. La pensée système est indispensable
  • Formation école d’ingénieur

Rémunération & avantages

La rémunération et les avantages sont calibrés selon les standards du marché local afin d’assurer un alignement compétitif avec le coût du travail et les benchmarks de talents régionaux.

Nous valorisons la profondeur technique, la prise de responsabilité et l’impact architectural.

Avantages proposés

  • Poste permanent ou freelancer à temps plein en Europe
  • Package d’avantages complet pris en charge par l’employeur
  • Salaire compétitif et mutuelle prise en charge à 100 %
  • Télétravail
  • Culture conviviale avec de réelles opportunités d’impact dans une équipe globale en croissance

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Environnement en forte croissance et en transformation
  • Modèle d’ingénierie AI-native
  • Problèmes d’infrastructure de haut niveau
  • Forte autonomie
  • Équipe senior à haute densité

Si vous valorisez le jugement, l’intégrité des systèmes et un impact technique significatif — parlons-en.

About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

We are currently seeking experienced and highly skilled English to Canadian French linguists to join our dynamic Life Sciences program specializing in Pharmacovigilance. This is an exciting opportunity to work on vital medical and clinical content, contributing to global health and safety initiatives.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of translations under tight deadlines. Many assignments are time-sensitive, requiring quick turnarounds to meet client expectations while maintaining the highest standards of quality.

Join our global team and help us make a difference in global health by delivering high-quality translations that support critical medical research and patient safety.

Key Details About the Role

  • Translate documents from English (US) to French (Canada), with a focus on pharmacovigilance content.
  • Perform Translation, Copy Editing (CE), and Machine Translation Post Editing (MTPE) tasks as required, ensuring high-quality standards and consistency.
  • Translate specialized medical and pharmaceutical content, including Product Monographs, Clinical Study Documents, and Medical Information Letters.
  • Adhere to tight deadlines, especially for projects received during EU close-of-business hours, with delivery required for early morning.
  • Work within the client-provided XTM and Phrase (Memsource) CAT tools (licenses will be provided).
  • Maintain professionalism, responsiveness, and reliability to meet client expectations and ensure timely delivery of assignments.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in medical and pharmaceutical translation, particularly for pharmaceutical companies or life sciences translation agencies in Quebec or Canada.
  • Specific expertise in translating Product Monographs and Medical Information Letters.
  • Bachelor’s degree in translation or a bachelor’s degree in science (e.g., pharmacology, biology, biochemistry) combined with a translation degree from a Quebec or Canadian university.
  • Membership in a Professional Order (e.g., OTTIAQ) is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in English (source language) and native-level proficiency in French (Canada) (target language).
  • Availability during US time zone business hours (location can be any country).
  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, and commitment to meeting deadlines under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Familiarity with CAT tools, specifically XTM and Phrase (Memsource) (training provided if necessary).
  • Ability to handle sensitive and technical content with confidentiality and precision.

Bonus if You Have

  • Experience working with high-volume, time-critical translation projects.
  • Strong background in pharmacovigilance, medical, or pharmaceutical content.
  • Previous experience working in collaborative environments with strict client guidelines.
  • Positive track record of professionalism and reliability in previous roles.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

The Fixed Video Deployment Team delivers video solutions to Public Safety and Enterprise customers across North America. We are committed to providing solutions that will allow customers to focus on their mission, and enable them to respond faster with smarter and safer decisions. We deploy and support products such as Vigilant LPR and Avigilon Video Systems.


Job Description

Under the general supervision of the Senior Systems Manager, the Service Delivery Technician serves as the primary point of contact for all customer-initiated support requests, including phone calls, emails, chat inquiries, and trouble tickets. This role is responsible for documenting and resolving first-level technical issues, performing remote troubleshooting, and escalating more complex, second-level issues to senior technical staff as needed. This position acts as a principal liaison between Customer end users and Motorola's Service department, ensuring timely and effective resolution of service-related issues. The primary objective of this role is to ensure a high level of Service availability for all Customer end users.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Function as a light training resource for Customer end users and non-technical staff; responsible for suggesting updates and improvements to existing training materials such as How-To guides, FAQs, KB articles and other instructional content.

  • Perform routine system health checks and visual inspections of cameras to ensure proper functionality and coverage. Conduct ad hoc reporting and asset audits as required to maintain an accurate inventory of VMS devices.
  • Perform routine hardware and software diagnostics on field equipment (cameras, encoders, network switches, media converters, etc.), identifying and resolving issues related to connectivity, performance, and functionality.
  • Assist with Customer end user account provisioning, including setting up user permissions and roles for viewing or managing video feeds, managing login credentials, and troubleshooting general access issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design engineers, field technicians, project managers and various technical groups to address complex issues and ensure smooth integration of video surveillance systems into larger IT infrastructures.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Attend standups, technical project engagements and other team meetings.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

    • Mobile Device Management (MDM) software

  • Basic network and server triage prior to escalation to senior personnel

raw.excerpt: Position OverviewThe Senior Manager Communications & Community Engagement is responsible for developing and executing strategic communications and community engagement programs that strengthen employee connection, advance our Purpose, enhance organizational culture, and build meaningful relationships with the communities in which the company operates.
raw.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Manager Communications & Community Engagement is responsible for developing and executing strategic communications and community engagement programs that strengthen employee connection, advance our Purpose, enhance organizational culture, and build meaningful relationships with the communities in which the company operates.

This role serves as a strategic communications partner to the Fujifilm Americas Corporate Communications Leadership Team, business leaders, Tokyo-Corporate Communications, Human Resources, and other key stakeholders. The manager translates business priorities into clear, compelling communications that inform, engage, and motivate employees while also supporting the company’s community engagement and social impact objectives.

The successful candidate is an experienced strategic communications professional with a demonstrated track record for developing strategic Communications & Engagement Plans/Strategies who can deliver in speedy, succinct, and real-time communications. The incumbent combines strong writing and storytelling skills with strategic thinking, demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, project management, stakeholder management, and an understanding of employee and community audiences.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. At Fujifilm you’ll have the opportunity to explore and grow your skills in new, exciting ways. Whether you’re shaping tomorrow’s tech or redefining today’s processes, we’ll provide a flexible work environment and dynamic culture where innovation thrives.

Our Americas HQ is nestled in Valhalla, New York, a charming town known for its excellent schools, beautiful parks, and easy access to the vibrancy of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Employee Communications

  • Develop and execute integrated employee communication strategies aligned with business objectives, Corporate Communications Strategy, company culture, and organizational priorities.
  • Partner with senior leaders and functional teams to develop clear, timely, and engaging communications for employees.
  • Create and manage communications across multiple channels, including email, intranet, digital platforms, employee meetings, town halls, videos, newsletters, presentations, and leadership communications.
  • Develop select executive communications, including talking points, leadership messages, presentations, town hall materials, and employee announcements.
  • Translate complex business information into concise, accessible, and compelling employee communications.
  • Support communications related to organizational change, business transformation, culture, employee engagement, and significant company initiatives.
  • Establish communication plans, timelines, audiences, messages, and channels for major initiatives.
  • Monitor employee feedback and engagement trends and recommend communications strategies based on employee needs and business priorities.

Community Engagement

  • Develop and implement community engagement strategies that support the company’s corporate citizenship and community investment priorities.
  • Partner with business leaders, employees, nonprofit organizations, and community partners to identify meaningful engagement opportunities.
  • Lead communications supporting volunteerism, charitable giving, employee-led community initiatives, and corporate social responsibility programs.
  • Develop stories and content that demonstrate the company’s impact in local communities.
  • Coordinate community events, employee volunteer activities, and engagement campaigns.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders to increase employee participation in community initiatives.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of community engagement programs.

Content & Storytelling

  • Develop compelling employee and community stories that reinforce company values, culture, Purpose, and business priorities.
  • Write and edit articles, newsletters, executive messages, presentations, social content, videos, and other communications materials.
  • Identify employee and community stories that can be leveraged across internal and external channels within FUJIFILM Americas, as well as amplified globally.
  • Ensure communications are consistent with the company’s brand, voice, tone, and communication standards.
  • Collaborate with social media, digital, HR, and external agency partners as appropriate.

Strategic Partnership & Leadership Support

  • Serve as a trusted, strategic communications advisor to leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Counsel stakeholders on communication strategy, audience considerations, timing, messaging, and delivery.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and understand business priorities and employee needs.
  • Provide communications support during organizational changes, business milestones, and other high-priority initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, accuracy, and deadlines.

Required Skills/Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field.
  • 10-12+ years of progressive experience in corporate communications, employee communications, public relations, community engagement, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing employee communication strategies.
  • Excellent writing, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience developing communications for multiple audiences and communication channels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a global or large corporate environment.
  • Experience supporting organizational change and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Experience with community relations, corporate social responsibility, employee volunteerism, or charitable giving programs.
  • Experience with executive communications.
  • Experience with internal digital communications platforms, intranets, employee apps, or collaboration tools.
  • Experience using employee engagement data, surveys, analytics, or other measures to inform communications strategy.
  • Communications agency experience is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Communications - Understands business objectives and translates them into effective communications strategies.
  • Executive Partnership - Builds credibility and trusted relationships with senior leaders and provides thoughtful communications counsel.
  • Writing & Storytelling - Creates clear, concise, compelling communications that connect with employees and community audiences.
  • Stakeholder Management - Effectively collaborates with leaders and partners across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization.
  • Employee Engagement - Understands employee audiences and develops communications that build connection, trust, understanding, and participation.
  • Community Engagement - Builds meaningful partnerships and creates opportunities for employees and the company to positively engage with communities.
  • Project Management - Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables.
  • Judgment & Discretion - Demonstrates sound judgment when managing sensitive information, complex issues, and high-visibility communications.

Success Measures

Success in this role may be measured through:

  • Employee engagement and participation in communications and community initiatives.
  • Quality, reach, and effectiveness of employee communications.
  • Stakeholder and leadership satisfaction.
  • Successful execution of communications strategies and major initiatives.
  • Employee understanding of key business priorities and organizational changes.
  • Growth in employee participation in volunteerism and community engagement.
  • Quality and consistency of communications across channels.
  • Demonstrated community impact and stakeholder relationships.

Role Characteristics

The Employee Communications & Community Engagement Manager is a strategic individual contributor and communications partner who operates with a high degree of independence. The position requires the ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution and to work effectively with senior leaders, Fujifilm Americas Corporate Communications Leadership, employees, HR, and community partners.

The role is particularly important in helping the organization connect employees to the company’s purpose, strategy, culture, and communities through credible, timely, and engaging communications.

Salary and Benefits

  • $95,000-$120,000 depending on experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off

EEO Information

Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc.

ADA Information

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department ().

You'll work directly with a senior engineer from day one, taking tier-2 client issues from "something's wrong" to a diagnosed, explained root cause.

What You'll Do

  • Dig into support tickets and client calls to find out what's actually going wrong, not just what the client assumes

  • Trace issues through logs, traces, and underlying data down to the code

  • Demo the platform live to show clients how to configure it for their exact workflow

  • Use AI tools daily to move faster through code and data than manual digging alone

  • Turn recurring headaches into permanent fixes instead of repeat tickets

What You'll Bring

  • A genuinely curious streak — you want to know why

What's In It For You

  • Work directly with senior engineering leadership from day one — no layers between you and real ownership

  • A genuine growth path: start in the ticket queue, graduate into leading your own investigations, reviewed at first, then trusted to run solo

  • High-visibility work on a platform trusted by firms managing tens of trillions in assets

  • Real flexibility on hours — not a buzzword, an actual confirmed policy

  • AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow, not an afterthought

Ready to trade scripted support for real investigation?

Apply now — next step is a conversation with our recruitment team.

raw.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is a leading provider of virtual-first care for weight health, diabetes, hypertension, and musculoskeletal issues. As a Senior Product Manager for Enterprise Solutions, you will lead advance discovery and help to shape strategic customer partnerships in support of Omada’s expansion into the payer, PBM and Provider ecosystem. You will operate between product squads and commercial teams, identifying gaps and opportunities, and advocating for the problems we should be solving with customers and potential partners. You will directly support the Senior Director, Product in high impact special projects. This is a dynamic position in which you will get exposure to many aspects of the business, and will have an opportunity to partner closely with other product managers on the team to build innovative programs and tools.

About you:

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • 10+ years of a combination of market and/or product strategy, product management, general management, software development, consulting, product or business operations
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience
  • Passionate about building experiences that people love to use
  • Able to think beyond constraints to imagine new ways to enroll and engage members
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong technical understanding
  • At home in ambiguous or green field opportunity spaces, with a track record of successfully bringing 0-1 products to market
  • Adept at solving problems with limited resources, and proactively advocating for whatever it is you need to succeed
  • Strong writer and clear communicator
  • Collaborative, and able to drive alignment in a group of stakeholders
  • Comfortable analyzing data and leading research/discovery efforts to understand a problem space, identify opportunities, and propose solutions
  • Human-centered product development and Continuous Discovery experience a plus
  • Experience leveraging AI/ML to personalize products and build efficient workflows a plus
  • Prior experience at a healthcare company a plus, especially in partnership with health insurers or PBMs
  • Prior experience with provider-side integrations, especially Epic is a plus

Your impact:

In this role, you’ll partner closely with our commercial organization to identify high impact partnership opportunities and shape the potential integration or product support the opportunity will require. You will:

  • Expand our partnership with PBMs and health insurers by making Omada the first choice in their portfolio for virtual-first care
  • Explore new verticals for Omada, like Provider partnerships as potential avenues for enrollments and member engagement
  • Cultivate an innovative environment that challengesyour cross-functional peers to think in new ways
  • Mentor and support other PMs on the team to hone their product management skills
  • Establish best practices for proactively tracking progress against corporate and team objectives

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer.
